p1_0.en: Mercury is the smallest and closest to the sun of the eight major planets in the solar system.
p1_0.cn: 水星是太阳系的八大行星中最小和最靠近太阳的行星。

p1_1.en: As seen from Earth, it conjuncts with Earth approximately every 116 days, its speed of revolution far surpasses other planets. Mercury's rapid movement led it to be named after Mercury (the swift-flying messenger god) in Roman mythology. In China, the ancients observed its deep gray color, black in the "Five Elements" belongs to water, hence the name Mercury.
p1_1.cn: 从地球上看，它大约116天左右与地球会合一次，公转速度远远超过其他星球。水星的快速运动使它在罗马神话中被称为墨丘利（快速飞行的信使神）。在中国，古人观其呈深灰色，黑色于“五行”属水，故命名为水星。

p1_2.en: Due to its extremely thin atmosphere, it cannot effectively retain heat, and the temperature difference between day and night on the surface of Mercury is the largest among the planets in the solar system. Mercury's axial tilt is the smallest of all the planets in the solar system, yet it has the largest orbital eccentricity (the distance at the aphelion is approximately 1.5 times that at the perihelion).
p1_2.cn: 由于大气层极为稀薄，无法有效保存热量，水星表面昼夜温差极大，为太阳系行星之最。水星的轴倾斜在太阳系所有行星中为最小，却拥有最大的轨道偏心率（远日点的距离大约是在近日点的1.5倍）。

p1_3.en: The surface of Mercury is filled with craters of various sizes, and it looks similar to the moon, indicating that its geology has been inactive for billions of years. It has no seasonal changes, and it is the only planet that resonates with the sun's orbit.
p1_3.cn: 水星表面充满了大大小小的坑穴，外观看起来与月球相似，显示出它的地质在数十亿年来都处于非活动状态，其无四季变化，它也是唯一与太阳轨道共振的行星。

p2_0.en: Venus is the second closest to the sun among the eight major planets in the solar system and has no satellites. In ancient China, it was known as Taibai, Morning Star, or DaXiao. It was called Qiming when it appeared in the east in the morning, and Changgeng when it appeared in the west at sunset. The ancients observed it as white, and in the "Five Elements", it belongs to metal, hence the name Venus.
p2_0.cn: 金星在太阳系的八大行星中距离太阳第二近，无卫星，在中国古代称为太白、明星或大嚣，早晨出现在东方称启明，日落出现在西方称长庚。古人观其为白色，于“五行”属金，故命名为金星。

p2_1.en: Venus is the second brightest natural object in the night sky after the moon, with an apparent magnitude of up to -4.7, bright enough to cast shadows. Venus is a terrestrial planet, and because its size, mass, volume, and distance to the sun are all similar to Earth, it is often referred to as Earth's sister planet. However, it has the thickest atmosphere of the four terrestrial planets (over 96% of which is carbon dioxide), the surface atmospheric pressure is 92 times that of Earth, and the average temperature is as high as 735K (462 °C), making it the hottest planet in the solar system, even hotter than Mercury, which is closest to the sun.
p2_1.cn: 金星在夜空中是亮度次于月球的第二亮的天然天体，视星等可达-4.7等，足以照射出影子。金星是一颗类地行星，因为它的大小、质量、体积与到太阳的距离均与地球相似，所以经常被称为地球的姊妹星。然而，它拥有四颗类地行星中最浓厚的大气层（其中超过96%为二氧化碳），表面大气压力是地球的92倍，平均温度高达735K（462 °C），是太阳系中最热的行星，甚至超过最靠近太阳的水星。

p2_2.en: Venus is covered by a layer of highly reflective, opaque sulfuric acid clouds, blocking visible light that might reach the surface from space. It may have had oceans in the past and looked very similar to Earth, but they all evaporated and dissipated as the runaway greenhouse effect caused temperatures to rise.
p2_2.cn: 金星被一层高反射、不透明的硫酸云覆盖着，阻挡了来自太空中可能抵达表面的可见光。它在过去可能拥有海洋，且外观与地球极为相似，但是随着失控的温室效应导致温度上升而全部蒸发散失。

p3_0.en: Earth is the third planet from the sun in the known solar system, and its average distance from the sun is called 1 astronomical unit (149597870.7km). It is the home of humans and currently the only celestial body known to harbor life in the universe.
p3_0.cn: 地球是太阳系中已知由内及外的第三颗行星，其与太阳的平均距离称为1个天文单位（149597870.7km）,是人类的家园，也是目前宇宙中唯一已知存在生命的天体。

p3_1.en: Earth simultaneously performs rotation and revolution, which respectively result in the alternation of day and night and the change of seasons. It rotates once in a solar day and revolves once in a solar year. The plane of rotation is called the equatorial plane, the plane of revolution is called the ecliptic plane, and the angle between the two is called the ecliptic-equatorial angle. Earth has only one natural satellite, the moon, which is tidally locked by Earth's gravity, always showing the same face to Earth. The plane of its orbit around Earth is called the lunar plane.
p3_1.cn: 地球同时进行着自转和公转运动，分别产生了昼夜及四季的变化更替，一太阳日自转一周，一太阳年公转一周。自转轨道面称为赤道面，公转轨道面称为黄道面，两者夹角称为黄赤交角。地球仅有一颗自然卫星月球，其被地球引力束缚潮汐锁定，永远只有同一面朝向地球，其绕行地球的公转的轨道面称为白道面。

p3_2.en: The surface of the Earth is covered by water (oceans, lakes, rivers) over 71% of its area, and the rest is continents and islands composed of land plates, with ice caps in Antarctica and ice in the Arctic. The main body includes the lithosphere, mantle, molten outer core of metal, and solid inner core of metal, with a geomagnetic field generated by the outer core. It is surrounded by a layer of gas, called the atmosphere, mainly composed of nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide, and argon.
p3_2.cn: 地球表面有71%的面积被水覆盖（海洋、湖泊、河流），其余是陆地板块组成的大洲和岛屿，南极的冰盖及北极存有冰。主体包括岩石圈、地幔、熔融态金属的外地核以及固态金属的内地核，拥有由外地核产生的地磁场。外部被气体包围，称为大气层，主要成分为氮、氧、二氧化碳、氩。

p3_3.en: Earth was born about 4.54 billion years ago, began to form oceans 4.2 billion years ago, and life appeared in the oceans 3.5 billion years ago, then gradually ventured onto the surface and into the atmosphere, and diversified into various species. According to statistics, there are about 1.2-1.4 million living species today, of which 1.2 million species have been recorded and confirmed to be alive. Currently, there are about 8.05 billion people on Earth, divided into about 200 countries and regions, connected through diplomacy, tourism, trade, media, or war.
p3_3.cn: 地球诞生于约45.4亿年前，42亿年前开始形成海洋，并在35亿年前的海洋中出现生命，之后逐步涉足地表和大气，并分化为各类种群。据统计，现今存活的物种大约有1,200-1,400万个，其中有记录证实存活的物种120万个。目前，地球上有约80.5 亿人口，分成了约200个国家和地区，借由外交、旅游、贸易、传媒或战争相互联系。

p4_0.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun, one of the four terrestrial planets, and the second smallest planet in the solar system, second only to Mercury. In the West, Mars is called Mars, the god of war in Roman mythology. In ancient Chinese, it was called Yinghuo because it glows like fire, and its position and brightness often change, making it elusive.
p4_0.cn: 火星是距离太阳第四近的行星，为四颗类地行星之一，也是太阳系中仅次于水星的第二小行星。西方称火星为玛尔斯，是罗马神话中的战神，古汉语中则因为它荧荧如火，位置、亮度时常变动让人无法捉摸而称之为荧惑。

p4_1.en: The diameter of Mars is about half that of Earth, and its axial tilt and rotation period are similar to Earth's, but its orbital period around the Sun is nearly twice as long as Earth's. From Earth, Mars is visible to the naked eye, with a brightness of up to -2.91 magnitude, only dimmer than Venus, the Moon, Jupiter, and the Sun.
p4_1.cn: 火星的直径约为地球的一半，自转轴倾角、自转周期则与地球相当，但绕太阳公转周期接近地球两倍。在地球上，火星肉眼可见，亮度可达-2.91等，只比金星、月球、木星和太阳暗。

p4_2.en: The atmosphere of Mars is primarily carbon dioxide, thin and cold. Its surface features remind people of valleys, deserts, and polar ice caps on Earth. Its southern hemisphere is an old, crater-filled highland, while the northern hemisphere is a younger plain. Mars has two natural satellites: Phobos and Deimos, which are irregular in shape and may be captured asteroids.
p4_2.cn: 火星大气以二氧化碳为主，既稀薄又寒冷，其表面特征让人联想起地球上的山谷、沙漠和极地冰盖。其南半球是古老、充满陨石坑的高地，北半球则是较年轻的平原。火星有两个天然卫星：火卫一和火卫二，形状不规则，可能是捕获的小行星。

p4_3.en: Mars has been explored by dozens of unmanned spacecraft: On November 28, 1964, Mariner 4, launched by NASA, was the first spacecraft to visit Mars, coming closest to the planet on July 15, 1965. It was followed by the Soviet Union's Mars 3, the European Space Agency's Mars Express, the Indian Space Research Organisation's Mars Orbiter Mission, the UAE's Hope Probe, and China's Tianwen-1. Because Mars is in the habitable zone of the solar system and there is more evidence that Mars once had an environment similar to Earth's, as well as abundant resources, Mars has become a focus of research for various countries. Both the United States and China have plans to send manned missions to Mars and establish bases there in the long term.
p4_3.cn: 火星已被数10艘无人航天器探索过：1964年11月28日，由NASA发射的水手4号是第一个访问火星的航天器，于1965年7月15日最接近该行星，其后有苏联的火星3号、欧洲空间局的火星快车号、印度空间研究组织的火星轨道探测器、阿联酋的希望号与及中国的天问一号。由于火星位于太阳系的宜居带，同时有更多证据证明火星曾拥有类似地球的环境，与及丰富的资源，故此火星成为各国研究的重点，其中美国及中国已有载人登陆火星的计划，长远在火星建立基地。

p5_0.en: Jupiter is the fifth planet from the Sun and the largest planet in the solar system. The Romans named this planet after their king of the gods, while ancient China called it the "Sui Star" (as it takes about 12 years to orbit the celestial sphere, matching the Chinese zodiac cycle). Due to its greenish color, which corresponds to the "wood" element in the "Five Elements" theory, it is also named Jupiter.
p5_0.cn: 木星是距离太阳第五近的行星，也是太阳系中体积最大的行星，罗马人以他们的神王称这颗行星，古代中国则称其为岁星（绕行天球一周约为12年与地支相同之故），因其呈青色同“五行”属木，又命名为木星。

p5_1.en: Jupiter's mass is one-thousandth of the Sun's, but it is 2.5 times the total mass of all other planets. As seen from Earth, its apparent magnitude can reach -2.94, which is bright enough to cast shadows, making it the third brightest celestial body in the night sky on average, after the Moon and Venus.
p5_1.cn: 木星的质量是太阳的千分之一，但却是其他行星质量总和的2.5倍。从地球看，它的视星等可以达到-2.94等，已经可以照出阴影，并使它成为继月球和金星之后夜空平均第三亮的天体。

p5_2.en: Jupiter is a gas giant with no clearly defined solid surface. Due to its rapid rotation, Jupiter appears oblate. The outer atmosphere forms different zones and belts according to latitude, with turbulence and storms at their boundaries. The Great Red Spot on its surface is a persistent anticyclonic storm larger than Earth, which has been continuously rotating since it was observed by telescopes in the 17th century.
p5_2.cn: 木星是气态巨行星，没有可以明确界定的固体表面。由于快速地自转，木星的外观呈现扁球体。外面的大气层依纬度成不同的区与带，在彼此的交界处有湍流和风暴作用着，其表面的大红斑是一个比地球还大的一个持久性反气旋风暴，从17世纪被望远镜观测到后一直持续旋转至今。

p5_3.en: Jupiter is surrounded by a faint ring system and a super powerful magnetosphere, including the four Galilean moons discovered in 1610 and 95 moons discovered as of February 2023. Among them, Ganymede, the third moon of Jupiter, is the largest moon in the solar system, even larger in diameter than the planet Mercury.
p5_3.cn: 环绕着木星的还有微弱的行星环和超级强大的磁层，包括4颗1610年发现的伽利略卫星和至2023年2月已经发现了的95颗卫星。其中，木卫三是太阳系中最大的卫星，其直径甚至大于行星中的水星。

p5_4.en: Several unmanned spacecraft have been sent to explore Jupiter, including early flyby missions like Pioneer and Voyager, and later ones like Galileo. The only operational probe currently in Jupiter's orbit is Juno.
p5_4.cn: 迄今已有数艘无人太空船前往木星探勘，其中包含早期飞掠任务的先锋号和旅行者号、后期的伽利略号等，目前木星轨道上唯一运作中的探测器是朱诺号。

p6_0.en: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun in terms of distance, and its size is second only to Jupiter. It, along with Jupiter, belongs to the category of gas giants. In Roman mythology, the name Saturn comes from Saturnus, the god of agriculture. In Greek mythology, it corresponds to Cronus (a Titan, and the father of Zeus). In ancient China, it was also called the "Zhen Star" or "Tian Star". Observing its earthy yellow color, which corresponds to the "earth" element in the "Five Elements" theory, it was named Saturn.
p6_0.cn: 土星至太阳距离由近到远位于第六、体积则仅次于木星，它与木星同属于气体（类木）巨行星。在罗马神话中土星的名称来自于农业之神萨图尔努斯（拉丁文：Saturnus），希腊神话中为克洛诺斯（泰坦族，宙斯的父亲）。古代中国亦称之为镇星、填星，因古人观察其呈土黄色，于“五行”属土，而命名为土星。

p6_1.en: Saturn is primarily composed of hydrogen, with a small amount of helium and trace elements. Its core consists of rock and ice, surrounded by several layers of metallic hydrogen and gas. Its outermost atmosphere usually appears bland, but its wind speeds can reach up to 1,800 kilometers per hour, and its magnetic field strength lies between that of Earth and the stronger Jupiter.
p6_1.cn: 土星主要由氢和少量的氦与微痕元素组成，内部的核心包括岩石和冰，外围由数层金属氢和气体包覆着，其最外层的大气在外观上看通常是平淡的，但其风速高达1,800公里/时，磁场强度介于地球和更强的木星之间。

p6_2.en: Saturn has a prominent ring system, primarily composed of ice particles, with fewer rock fragments and dust. Saturn has 146 confirmed moons, most of which are very small in size. Among them, Titan (Saturn's sixth moon) is the largest in the Saturn system and the second largest in the solar system, even larger than the planet Mercury. Moreover, Titan is the only moon with a significant atmosphere.
p6_2.cn: 土星有一个显著的行星环系统，主要的成分是冰的微粒和较少数的岩石残骸以及尘土。土星已经确认的卫星有146颗，但绝大多数体积很小，其中，土卫六（泰坦）是土星系统中最大和太阳系中第二大的卫星，比行星中的水星还要大，并且土卫六还是唯一拥有明显大气层的卫星。

p7_0.en: Uranus is the seventh planet from the Sun and is a blue planet. It ranks third in size and fourth in mass in the solar system. Its name comes from Uranus, the god of the sky in ancient Greek mythology (the father of Cronus and the grandfather of Zeus). In Western culture, Uranus is the only planet named after a Greek deity (the others are named after Roman deities).
p7_0.cn: 天王星是距离太阳第七近的青色行星，其体积在太阳系中排名第三、质量排名第四。它的命名来自古希腊神话的天空之神乌拉诺斯（克洛诺斯的父亲、宙斯的祖父）。在西方文化中，天王星是唯一以希腊神祇命名的行星（其他都依照罗马神祇命名）。

p7_1.en: Compared to the five planets known in ancient times, Uranus was not recognized as a planet due to its dimness and slow orbital speed. It was not until March 13, 1781, that Sir William Herschel announced the discovery of Uranus, thereby expanding the known boundaries of the solar system in modern history for the first time.
p7_1.cn: 与在古代就为人们所知的五颗行星相比，天王星由于较为黯淡以及缓慢的绕行速度而未被认定为是一颗行星。直到1781年3月13日，威廉·赫歇耳爵士宣布发现天王星，从而太阳系在现代史上首度扩展已知的界限。

p7_2.en: Uranus and Neptune both belong to the category of "ice giants", with their internal and atmospheric compositions differing from the larger "gas giants", Jupiter and Saturn. The main components of its atmosphere are hydrogen and helium, but it also contains a higher proportion of "ices" formed by water, ammonia, and methane. Uranus has the coldest atmosphere of any planet in the solar system, with a minimum temperature of only 49K (-224°C).
p7_2.cn: 天王星和海王星同属于“冰巨行星”，其内部和大气构成不同于更巨大的“气体巨星”木星和土星。它的大气的主要成分是氢和氦，还包含较高比例的由水、氨、甲烷等结成的“冰”。天王星是太阳系内大气层最冷的行星，最低温度只有49K（-224℃）。

p7_3.en: Like other giant planets, Uranus also has a ring system, magnetosphere, and many moons. However, its ring system is very unique among the planets because its rotation axis is tilted to one side, almost lying on the orbital plane of the Sun, so its poles also lie in the equatorial positions of other planets. From Earth, the rings of Uranus look like rings around a target, and its moons look like hands around a clock.
p7_3.cn: 如同其它的巨行星一样，天王星也有环系统、磁层和许多卫星，但它的环系统在行星中非常独特，因为它的自转轴斜向一边，几乎就躺在公转太阳的轨道平面上，因而其南北极也躺在其他行星的赤道位置上。从地球看，天王星的环像是环绕着标靶的圆环，它的卫星则像环绕着钟的指针。

p8_0.en: Neptune is the furthest planet from the Sun among the eight planets in the solar system, ranking fourth in size and third in mass. It is named after Neptune (Latin: Neptunus) in Roman mythology. As Neptune was the god of the sea, the planet is translated as "Neptune" in Chinese.
p8_0.cn: 海王星在太阳系八大行星中距离太阳最远，体积排第四，质量排第三，以罗马神话中的尼普顿（拉丁文：Neptunus）命名，因为尼普顿是海神王，所以中文译为海王星。

p8_1.en: As an ice giant, Neptune's atmosphere is primarily composed of hydrogen and helium, with trace amounts of methane. Its density is higher than that of Uranus, which is very similar. The methane in its atmosphere is partly why its surface appears blue.
p8_1.cn: 作为一个冰巨行星，海王星的大气层以氢和氦为主，还有微量的甲烷，其密度比极为类似的天王星密度更高。其大气层中的甲烷，是使其表面呈现蓝色的部分原因。

p8_2.en: Neptune has the strongest winds in the solar system, with measured wind speeds reaching up to 2,100 kilometers per hour. The temperature at the top of the Great Dark Spot in its southern hemisphere is 55K (-218°C). Being the furthest from the Sun, it is, on average, one of the coldest regions in the solar system.
p8_2.cn: 海王星有着太阳系最强烈的风，测量到的风速高达每小时2,100千米。其南半球的大暗斑云顶的温度是55K（-218℃），因为距离太阳最远，就平均而言是太阳系中最冷的地区之一。

p8_3.en: Neptune was discovered on September 23, 1846, and is the only planet found through mathematical prediction rather than planned observation (astronomers inferred the existence and possible location of Neptune from the perturbations in Uranus's orbit). To date, only Voyager 2 has flown past Neptune, on August 25, 1989. On July 12, 2022, the James Webb Space Telescope photographed Neptune again, capturing the faint rings of Neptune clearly for the first time in over 30 years.
p8_3.cn: 海王星发现于1846年9月23日，是唯一通过数学预测而非有计划的观测发现的行星（天文学家利用天王星轨道的摄动推测出海王星的存在与可能的位置）。迄今仅有旅行者2号曾在1989年8月25日飞掠过海王星。2022年7月12日，詹姆斯韦伯望远镜再次对海王星进行了拍摄，30多年来首次清晰地拍摄到海王星存在微弱的星环。

s3-1_0.en: Earth's moon, colloquially known as the Moon, is the only natural satellite of Earth. Its diameter is roughly a quarter of the Earth's, and its mass is about 1/81 of Earth's. The Moon is the fifth largest satellite in the solar system and has the second highest density of any moon in the solar system, second only to Io of Jupiter.
s3-1_0.cn: 地卫一即月球，俗称月亮，是地球唯一的天然卫星，直径约等于地球的1/4，质量约为地球的1/81。月球是太阳系中第五大的卫星，也是太阳系内密度第二高的卫星（仅次于木卫一）。

s3-1_1.en: It is generally believed to have formed about 4.5 billion years ago, shortly after the emergence of Earth. There are several hypotheses regarding its origin, but none can fully and flawlessly explain it. The most widely accepted is the Great Impact theory. The Moon is also the first extraterrestrial body humans have ever landed on. Its rotation is synchronized with its revolution (tidally locked), therefore it always presents the same face towards Earth.
s3-1_1.cn: 一般认为它形成于约45亿年前，即地球出现后的不久，有关它的起源有几种假说，但没有一种能完全合理地作毫无破绽的解释，其中最被普遍认可的是大碰撞说。月球也是第一个人类曾经登陆过的地外星球，它的自转与公转同步（潮汐锁定），因此以同一面朝向地球。

s4-1_0.en: Phobos, with an average radius of 11.1 kilometers, is the larger and closer of the two natural satellites of Mars. Its name, Phobos, is derived from a son of the Roman god of war, Mars. Phobos is an irregularly shaped small celestial body, whose orbit is about 9400 kilometers from the center of Mars, closer to its parent planet than any other known satellite in the solar system.
s4-1_0.cn: 火卫一平均半径为11.1公里，是火星的两颗自然卫星中，距离火星较近且较大的一颗。其名称福波斯为罗马神话战神马尔斯之子。火卫一是一个形状不规则的小天体，轨道距火星中心约9400公里，到其母星的距离比太阳系其他已知行星的卫星都要近。

s4-1_1.en: Phobos is one of the least reflective bodies in the solar system and has a large impact crater called Stickney Crater. Because its orbit is very close to Mars, Phobos rotates faster than Mars' self-rotation. Therefore, viewed from the surface of Mars, Phobos rises in the west, crosses the sky in 4 hours 15 minutes or less, and sets in the east.
s4-1_1.cn: 火卫一是太阳系中反射率最低的天体之一，有一个巨大的撞击坑，叫斯蒂克尼撞击坑。由于轨道离火星很近，火卫一的转动快于火星的自转。因此，从火星表面看，火卫一从西边升起，在4小时15分钟或更短的时间内划过天空，在东边落山

s4-2_0.en: Deimos is the smallest moon of Mars with an irregular shape and an average radius of 6.2 kilometers. It is 23,460 kilometers away from Mars and orbits Mars every 30.3 hours at a speed of 1.35 kilometers per second. Deimos is named after the personification of fear in Greek mythology.
s4-2_0.cn: 火卫二是火星最小的一颗卫星，形状不规则，平均半径为6.2千米，与火星的距离是23,460千米，并以30.3小时的周期环绕火星，轨道速度为每秒1.35公里。火卫二被命名为得摩斯，是希腊神话中表示恐惧的形像。

s5-1_0.en: Io is the innermost moon of Jupiter and the fourth largest moon in the solar system. Its name comes from Io, one of the lovers of Zeus, the king of the gods, who was a priestess of Hera. Io is the most volcanically active body in the solar system, and its surface is filled with sulfur and sulfides, forming spots of various colors. Volcanic activity gives Io a very thin atmosphere mainly composed of sulfur dioxide.
s5-1_0.cn: 木卫一是木星的最内侧的卫星，也是太阳系第四大卫星。名字来自众神之王宙斯的恋人之一：艾奥，她是希拉的女祭司。艾奥是太阳系中最活跃的火山体，它的表面充满了硫和硫化物，形成了多种颜色的斑点。火山活动使得Io拥有极薄的大气层，主要由二氧化硫构成。

s5-2_0.en: Europa, Jupiter's smallest Galilean moon, is named after a beautiful Phoenician princess in Greek mythology. Its surface is covered with ice and it is considered one of the most likely places within the solar system to harbor life. Beneath its icy surface, a vast ocean is believed to exist, potentially twice the volume of all Earth's oceans combined. The cracks and fault lines visible on its surface are likely caused by tidal forces.
s5-2_0.cn: 木卫二是木星的四颗伽利略卫星中最小的一颗，被命名为欧罗巴（是希腊神话中的美丽腓尼基公主），表面覆盖着冰，被认为是太阳系中最有可能存在生命的地方之一。其下可能隐藏着一个巨大的海洋，这个海洋的体积可能是地球所有海洋的两倍。其表面的裂缝和断层线可能是由潮汐力造成的

s5-3_0.en: Ganymede is the seventh moon from Jupiter in terms of proximity and the third of the Galilean moons. It maintains a 1:2:4 orbital resonance with Io and Europa. Named after Ganymede, the cupbearer of the gods and the lover of Zeus in Greek mythology, it is the largest moon in the solar system, with a diameter even larger than that of Mercury, but with only about half of Mercury's mass. Ganymede is the only moon with its own magnetic field and its surface is composed of ice and rock. Its internal structure may include a vast ocean, containing more water than Earth.
s5-3_0.cn: 木卫三在木星的卫星中按距离从近到远排第七，在伽利略卫星中排第三，它与木卫二及木卫一保持着1:2:4的轨道共振关系，以希腊神话中神的斟酒者、宙斯的爱人盖尼米德命名。他也是太阳系中最大的卫星，其直径甚至大于水星，而质量约只为水星的一半。它是唯一拥有自己磁场的卫星，表面有冰和岩石。其的内部结构可能包括一个大海洋，含有更多的水比地球。

s5-4_0.en: Callisto is Jupiter's second-largest moon and the third-largest moon in the solar system, named after one of Zeus's lovers, Callisto, in Greek mythology. Unlike the three inner Galilean moons (Io, Europa, and Ganymede) which are in orbital resonance, Callisto does not exhibit a significant tidal heating effect.
s5-4_0.cn: 木卫四是木星的第二大卫星，也是太阳系中第三大的卫星，命名来自希腊神话中宙斯的爱人之一卡里斯托。木卫四并不像内层的三颗伽利略卫星（木卫一、二和三）那般处于轨道共振状态，所以并不存在明显的潮汐热效应。

s5-4_1.en: Its surface is one of the oldest and most cratered in the solar system, largely composed of ice and rock. Its interior may be partially differentiated, but not to the extent of other Jovian moons with clear-cut rocky cores and icy mantles.
s5-4_1.cn: 其表面是太阳系中最古老和最坑洼的地表之一，几乎完全由冰和岩石构成，内部可能是部分分层的，但不像其他的木星卫星那样具有明显的岩石核心和冰壳。

s6-1_0.en: Mimas, also known as "Saturn I", is a moon of Saturn, discovered by William Herschel in 1789, named after Mimas, the son of Gaia in Greek mythology. With an average diameter of only 396 kilometers, Mimas is the smallest body in the known solar system to have achieved hydrostatic equilibrium.
s6-1_0.cn: 土卫一又称为“弥玛斯”，是土星的一颗卫星，1789年由威廉·赫歇尔发现，它以希腊神话中的盖亚之子Mimas命名。土卫一的平均直径仅有396公里，是已知的太阳系中最小的达到流体静力平衡的天体。

s6-2_0.en: Enceladus, also known as "Saturn II", is the sixth-largest moon of Saturn, discovered by William Herschel in 1789 and named after the Titan Enceladus in Greek mythology.
s6-2_0.cn: 土卫二又称为“恩克拉多斯”，是土星的第六大卫星，于1789年为威廉·赫歇尔所发现，以希腊神话中的泰坦巨人恩克拉多斯命名。

s6-2_1.en: Before the Voyager missions probed Saturn in the 1980s, Enceladus was known only as an icy moon. Voyager showed that Enceladus has a diameter of about 500 kilometers and its surface reflects almost 100% of the sunlight. Voyager 2 also revealed that, despite its small size, the surface of the moon exhibits both ancient impact craters and younger, tectonically twisted terrain caused by geological activity - some of these geological features may be as young as 100 million years old.
s6-2_1.cn: 在旅行者号于1980年代探测土星之前，人们只知道土卫二是一个被冰覆盖的卫星。旅行者号显示土卫二直径约为500公里，而且其表面几乎能反射百分之百的阳光。旅行者2号则发现：尽管该卫星体积不大，但是在其表面既存在古老的撞击坑构造，又存在较为年轻的、地质活动所造成的扭曲地形构造——其中一些地区的地质年代甚至只有1亿年。

s6-3_0.en: Tethys, also known as "Saturn III", is a moon of Saturn. It was discovered by Italian scientist Giovanni Domenico Cassini on March 21, 1684, and named after Tethys, a Titan in Greek mythology.
s6-3_0.cn: 土卫三又称为“特堤斯”（Tethys），是一颗土星的卫星，由意大利科学家乔瓦尼·多梅尼科·卡西尼在1684年3月21日发现，并根据希腊神话泰坦的特堤斯来命名。

s6-3_1.en: Made of ice, similar to Saturn's satellites V and IV, Tethys has a density of 0.97g/cm3. Its surface has been severely impacted by celestial bodies and has many ice fractures. Tethys is one of the bodies with the highest albedos in the solar system, with a reflectance as high as 1.229. Tethys also boasts two different types of terrains, one consisting of many pockmarks, and the other composed of dark volcanic zones.
s6-3_1.cn: 土卫三由冰所构成，类似土卫五与土卫四，其密度为0.97g/cm3。其表面受到天体严重的撞击，并拥有许多冰裂缝。土卫三是太阳系反射率最高的天体之一，反射率高达到1.229。土卫三还拥有着2种不同的地形，其中一种是由许多坑洞所构成的，而另一种地形则是黑暗的火山带所组成的。

s6-3_2.en: The second major feature of Tethys is the enormous Ithaca Chasma, which is 100 kilometers wide and 3 to 5 kilometers deep. It stretches 2,000 kilometers long, which is about 3/4 of the circumference of Tethys.
s6-3_2.cn: 土卫三的第2个主要特征是巨大的伊萨卡峡谷（Ithaca Chasma），它宽100公里，深3至5公里。它延伸了2,000公里长，大约是土卫三圆周长的3/4。

s6-4_0.en: Dione, also known as Saturn IV, is a moon orbiting Saturn. It was discovered in 1684 by Giovanni Domenico Cassini and named after the Titaness in Greek mythology. The International Astronomical Union suggests that, like Saturn II and Saturn VI, Dione may also have a subsurface ocean.
s6-4_0.cn: 土卫四又称为“狄俄涅”，是环绕土星运行的一颗卫星，它在1684年由乔瓦尼·多梅尼科·卡西尼发现，并以希腊神话中的泰坦巨人命名。国际天文协会将它按照如同土卫二和土卫六，土卫四内部也可能存在一层地下海洋。

s6-4_1.en: Primarily composed of ice, Dione is the third densest among Saturn's moons (Saturn II and Saturn VI rank first and second), implying that its interior must contain a substantial amount of silicate rock. The front of Dione has many impact craters and is relatively bright, while its back is completely different. The back side is darker, with bright, fine stripes covering the impact craters, which are speculated to be cliffs of ice.
s6-4_1.cn: 土卫四主要由冰组成，不过它是土星卫星中密度第三高的（土卫二和土卫六居第一和第二位），因此它的内部必须含有相当多的硅酸盐岩石。土卫四的正面有比较多的撞击坑，而且比较亮，而它的反面则完全不同，这一面比较暗，明亮的、细小的条纹遮盖了上面的撞击坑，这些条纹估计是冰的悬崖。

s6-5_0.en: Rhea, also known as Saturn V, is the second-largest moon orbiting Saturn and the ninth-largest moon in the solar system. It was discovered in 1672 by the French astronomer Giovanni Domenico Cassini and named after Rhea, one of the twelve Titans and the mother of the gods in Greek mythology.
s6-5_0.cn: 土卫五又称为“瑞亚”，是环绕土星运行的第二大卫星，并为太阳系中第九大的卫星。它由法国天文学家乔瓦尼·多梅尼科·卡西尼于1672年所发现，并以希腊神话中十二泰坦巨神之一瑞亚（众神之母）命名。

s6-5_1.en: Rhea shares some characteristics with Dione, suggesting they may have similar compositions and histories. The temperature in Rhea's sunlit areas is about 99 Kelvin (-174 degrees Celsius), while the temperature in shaded areas ranges between -200 and -220 degrees Celsius.
s6-5_1.cn: 土卫五的特征有些类似土卫四，这显示它们可能有类似组成与历史。土卫五受到日照地区的温度为开氏99度（摄氏-174度），而阴影地区的温度则介于摄氏-200度与摄氏-220度之间。

s6-5_2.en: Rhea's surface has distinct craters and bright, subtle features. Its surface can be divided into two different geographical areas based on crater density. The first area includes craters with diameters greater than 40 kilometers, while the second area is the opposite and is located in polar and equatorial regions. This also indicates that large-scale reorganization events occurred during Rhea's formation process.
s6-5_2.cn: 土卫五的表面有明显的坑洞与明亮的细微特征。它的表面根据坑洞密度可以被分成2个不同的地理区域，第一个地区包括直径在40公里以上的坑洞，而第二个地区则相反，并位在极区与赤道地区。这也显示在土卫五形成的过程中曾经发生大规模的重组事件。

s6-6_0.en: Titan, also known as Saturn VI, is the largest moon orbiting Saturn and the second-largest moon in the solar system (only smaller than Jupiter's largest moon, Ganymede), with a volume even larger than the planet Mercury.
s6-6_0.cn: 土卫六又称为“泰坦”（Titan），是环绕土星的卫星中最大的一个，也是太阳系第二大的卫星（仅次于木星最大的卫星木卫三），体积甚至比行星水星还大。

s6-6_1.en: It was discovered on March 25, 1655, by Dutch physicist, astronomer, and mathematician Christiaan Huygens, and was named after the Titans in Greek mythology (the collective name for Saturn and his siblings). It was the first moon discovered in the solar system after Jupiter's Galilean moons. As it was the first moon in the solar system discovered to have a thick atmosphere, there is high suspicion of the existence of life, with scientists speculating that the methane in the atmosphere could be a basis for life. Titan can be seen as a time machine, helping us understand the initial conditions of Earth and unravel the mystery of how Earth's life was born (although its mass is not as large as Mercury's).
s6-6_1.cn: 荷兰物理学家、天文学家和数学家克里斯蒂安·惠更斯在1655年3月25日发现它，后以希腊神话中的泰坦巨人命名（萨图恩和他的兄弟姊妹们的统称），也是在太阳系内继木星伽利略卫星后发现的第一颗卫星。由于它是太阳系第一颗被发现拥有浓厚大气层的卫星，因此被高度怀疑有生命体的存在，科学家也推测大气中的甲烷可能是生命体的基础。土卫六可以被视为一个时光机器，有助我们了解地球最初期的情况，揭开地球生物如何诞生之谜。（虽然质量没有水星大）。

s6-6_2.en: Observations made by the Cassini spacecraft in 2004 indicate that Titan is a "super rotator," like Venus, with its atmospheric rotation speed far exceeding that of its surface.
s6-6_2.cn: 卡西尼号在2004年对其进行的观测表明，土卫六是一个“超级旋转体”，就像金星一样，其大气层旋转速度远快于表面。

s6-7_0.en: Hyperion, also known as Saturn VII, is a small moon orbiting Saturn.
s6-7_0.cn: 土卫七又称为海柏利昂，是环绕土星运行的一颗小卫星。

s6-7_1.en: In 1848, American astronomer George Bond and Britain's William Lassell independently discovered Hyperion, which is 1,482,000 kilometers from Saturn. It appears like a fragment of a larger body, with a surface that is mysteriously sponge-like. It is currently the largest non-spherical celestial body discovered in the solar system, and one of the celestial bodies in the solar system with an irregular rotation. It orbits Saturn every 21.3 days.
s6-7_1.cn: 1848年美国天文学家乔治·邦德和英国的威廉·拉塞尔各自独立发现土卫七，距土星1482000公里，像大星体的碎片，表面不知为何有如海绵，是目前所发现太阳系中最大的一颗非球形天体，也是太阳系中，自转不规则的星体之一，每21.3天绕土星旋转一周。

s6-8_0.en: Iapetus, also known as Saturn VIII, is the third-largest moon of Saturn and the 11th largest moon in the solar system. It was discovered by Giovanni Domenico Cassini in 1671 and named after one of the Titan giants, the brother of Saturn in Greek mythology. Iapetus is renowned for the significant color difference between its two hemispheres, and recent discoveries by the Cassini spacecraft have revealed other unusual features of the moon, such as an equatorial ridge that circles half the globe.
s6-8_0.cn: 土卫八又称为“伊阿珀托斯”，是土星的第3大卫星，同时也是太阳系中的第11大卫星，由乔瓦尼·多梅尼科·卡西尼于1671年发现，并以希腊神话中萨图恩的兄弟、泰坦巨人之一命名。土卫八以其两半球面巨大的颜色差异而著称，而卡西尼号最近的发现则揭示了该卫星其他多处不寻常的特征，如其拥有一个环绕球体半圈的赤道脊。

s6-8_1.en: Unlike most moons, Iapetus is not spherical or ellipsoidal in overall shape. Its equatorial region protrudes, while the polar regions are recessed. Meanwhile, the unique ridges in its equatorial region are astonishingly high, so much so that these topographical changes to the moon's shape can be observed from afar. These features make Iapetus appear more walnut-shaped.
s6-8_1.cn: 不同于大部分的卫星，土卫八的整体外形并非球形或椭球形，它的赤道部分凸出，而两极地区凹陷；同时其赤道地区独特的山脊高度惊人，甚至在远处观测都能发现这种地形改变了这颗卫星的形状。这些特征使得土卫八看起来更像核桃形的。

s7-1_0.en: Ariel, one of Uranus's moons, was discovered along with Umbriel by William Lassell on October 24, 1851, and named after the sprite Ariel from Shakespeare's "The Tempest".
s7-1_0.cn: 天卫一由威廉·拉塞尔在1851年10月24日和天卫二一起被发现，命名来自于莎士比亚的作品《暴风雨》中精灵艾瑞尔。

s7-1_1.en: Approximately 70% of Ariel is composed of ice (combined water ice and dry ice, possibly methane ice) and the remaining 30% is silicate. The largest and oldest geologic feature observed on Ariel by Voyager 2 is a volcanic plain near the south pole.
s7-1_1.cn: 天卫一大约有70%是由冰（水冰与二氧化碳冰，可能也有甲烷冰）所构成的，而剩下30%则是硅酸盐。旅行者二号观测到天卫一上最大及最古老的地质特征是靠近南极的火山平原。

s7-2_0.en: Umbriel, named after a character in Alexander Pope's "The Rape of the Lock", was discovered simultaneously with Ariel by William Lassell on October 24, 1851.
s7-2_0.cn: 天卫二以亚历山大·蒲柏的作品《秀发劫》里的角色乌姆柏里厄尔命名，它与天卫一同时由威廉·拉塞尔在1851年10月24日发现。

s7-2_1.en: Umbriel's diameter is 10 kilometers larger than Ariel's, but its density is the same. It is primarily composed of ice and rock, with ice making up the majority of Umbriel's surface, and its mantle and core are likely made up of ice and rock, respectively. Umbriel is the darkest of all Uranus' moons, with a reflectivity of only 18%, and its surface is marked by numerous canyons. There may have been intense crustal changes within its interior.
s7-2_1.cn: 天卫二的直径比天卫一大10公里，但密度相同。天卫二主要由冰和岩石组成，其中冰占天卫二表面的多数，而它的地幔和核心可能分别由冰和岩石组成。天卫二是天王星所有卫星中最暗的，反射率只有18％，表面有多处峡谷，内部可能有过剧烈的地壳变动事件。

s7-3_0.en: Titania, the largest moon of Uranus and the eighth largest in the solar system, was discovered by William Herschel in 1787 and named after Titania, the fairy queen from Shakespeare's "A Midsummer Night's Dream".
s7-3_0.cn: 天卫三是天王星最大的卫星，也是太阳系内第八大的卫星。1787年由威廉·赫歇尔发现，并以莎士比亚的《仲夏夜之梦》中的妖精王后提坦尼亚命名。

s7-3_1.en: Its orbit lies within Uranus' internal magnetic layer and it is composed of roughly equal portions of ice and rock. It may be divided into a rocky core and a frigid mantle, with a layer of liquid water possibly existing at the core-mantle boundary. Its surface is relatively dark, slightly reddish in color, and covered with volcanic ash.
s7-3_1.cn: 它的轨道位于天王星的内部磁层，由大约等量的冰和岩石组成，可能分为岩石核心和冰冷的地幔，在核幔边界处可能存在一层液态水。其表面相对较暗，颜色略带红色，覆满了火山灰。

s7-4_0.en: Oberon, Uranus's most distant major moon, ranks second among Uranus's moons both in terms of volume and mass, and it is also the ninth largest moon in the solar system by mass. This moon was first observed by British astronomer William Herschel in 1787. The name Oberon is derived from Shakespeare's "A Midsummer Night's Dream" and European folklore, named after Oberon, the fairy king.
s7-4_0.cn: 天卫四是距离天王星最远的大卫星，其体积和质量在天王星所有卫星中均位列次席，同时也是太阳系质量第九大的卫星。英国天文学家威廉·赫歇尔在1787年首次观测到该卫星。名称奥伯隆来自于莎士比亚的《仲夏夜之梦》及欧洲民间传说中的妖精之王奥伯隆。

s7-4_1.en: Oberon is composed of nearly equal amounts of water ice and rock, with its interior possibly differentiating into a rocky core and icy mantle. Furthermore, there may be a layer of liquid water between the core and mantle. Its surface is dark red, primarily shaped by the impact of asteroids and comets.
s7-4_1.cn: 天卫四由近乎等量的冰体水和岩石构成，其内部可能分化出岩石内核及冰质地幔。此外，在内核和地幔之间可能还存在着一层液态水,表面呈暗红色，其主要地形是小行星和彗星撞击后所形成的。

s7-5_0.en: Miranda, the smallest and innermost of Uranus's five spherical moons, was discovered on February 16, 1948, by Gerard Kuiper at the McDonald Observatory in Texas, USA. It was named after Miranda, the daughter of the protagonist Prospero in Shakespeare's play "The Tempest".
s7-5_0.cn: 天卫五是天王星五颗球形卫星中最小和最内侧的一颗。由杰拉德·古柏（柯伊伯）在1948年2月16日在美国德州的麦克唐纳天文台发现的，并以莎士比亚的歌剧《暴风雪》中主角普洛斯彼罗的女儿米兰达命名。

s7-5_1.en: Like the other major moons of Uranus, Miranda's orbit is close to the planet's equatorial plane. However, since Uranus orbits the Sun on its side, Miranda's orbit is almost perpendicular to the ecliptic, and it experiences the same extreme climactic cycles as Uranus.
s7-5_1.cn: 像天王星的其它大卫星一样，米兰达的轨道靠近其行星的赤道面。由于天王星是侧躺的绕着太阳运行，因此米兰达的轨道几乎垂直于黄道，并且与天王星一样有着相同的极端气候周期。

s7-15_0.en: Puck, or Uranus XV, was discovered in December 1985 by Voyager 2. The name comes from the mischievous sprite Puck in Celtic mythology, who, in Shakespeare's "A Midsummer Night's Dream", could travel the world with fairies in a single night.
s7-15_0.cn: 天卫十五于1985年12月被旅行者2号发现，名称来自凯尔特神话中的淘气精灵波克（在莎士比亚的《仲夏夜之梦》中，她可以在一夜之间和仙女游遍全球）。

s7-15_1.en: Puck orbits between Uranus's rings and the major moon Miranda. It is a near-spherical body with a diameter of approximately 162 kilometers, characterized by a large, dark pit on its surface that displays spectral indications of water ice. Puck is the largest of Uranus's small inner moons and is a mid-sized satellite.
s7-15_1.cn: 天卫十五位于天王星环和大卫星米兰达之间，是一颗直径大约162公里，形状接近球形的天体，表面有一个大且黑暗的坑穴，其中的光谱呈现水冰的迹象。天卫十五是天王星最大的小内侧卫星，是中等大小的卫星。

s8-1_0.en: Triton is Neptune's largest natural satellite and the only one massive enough to have achieved hydrostatic equilibrium. It is also the seventh-largest moon in our solar system and the only large satellite with a retrograde orbit (orbiting opposite to the planet's rotation). Due to its retrograde orbit and its similar composition and structure to Pluto, it is generally believed to be a dwarf planet captured from the Kuiper Belt.
s8-1_0.cn: 海卫一是海王星最大的天然卫星，也是海王星中唯一一颗质量足以达到流体静力平衡的卫星。海卫一也是太阳系中的第七大卫星，唯一具有逆行轨道的大型卫星（轨道与母行星自转方向相反），由于其轨道逆行，成分、结构又皆与冥王星相似，一般认为它可能是一颗从柯伊伯带捕获的矮行星。

s8-1_1.en: Its surface is primarily frozen nitrogen, composed of a crust of water ice, a cold mantel, and an abundant core of rock and metal, making it one of the coldest bodies in the solar system. Triton was named after the Greek sea god.
s8-1_1.cn: 其表面主要是冰冻的氮，由水冰壳、冰冷的地幔以及大量的岩石和金属核心所构成，是太阳系中最冷的天体之一。其特里同的命名源于希腊海神。

s8-8_0.en: Proteus, or Neptune VIII, is the second largest satellite orbiting Neptune, and Neptune's largest inner moon. Its size is near the limit for irregular bodies.
s8-8_0.cn: 海卫八是环绕海王星运行的第二大的卫星，也是海王星的最大内卫星，它的大小已经接近不规则星体的极限。

s8-8_1.en: Proteus is one of the darkest objects in the solar system, as dark as soot, and it was discovered from images taken by Voyager 2 during its Neptune flyby in 1989. Its name, Proteus, is derived from the shape-shifting sea god in Greek mythology.
s8-8_1.cn: 海卫八是已知太阳系内最暗的天体之一，它像煤烟那么黑，由旅行者2号在1989年飞经海王星所摄取的图像而发现。其名称普罗透斯源于希腊神话中会变形的海神。

s9-1_0.en: Charon, or Pluto I, is the largest of the five known natural satellites of Pluto, with an average radius of 606 kilometers. Its name comes from Charon, the ferryman of the dead in Greek mythology, who is closely associated with the god Hades (also known as Pluto in Roman mythology).
s9-1_0.cn: 冥卫一是冥王星其已知五颗自然卫星中最大的一颗，平均半径为606公里。命名来自于希腊神话中死者的摆渡卡戎，与冥王哈迪斯（在罗马神话中称普鲁托）紧密联系在一起的神祇。

s9-1_1.en: Charon is also the sixth-largest trans-Neptunian object known, only smaller than Pluto, Eris, Haumea, Quaoar, and Makemake. It was discovered in 1978 by James Christy. Its surface features many impact craters and icebergs.
s9-1_1.cn: 冥卫一也是已知的第六大海王星外天体，仅次于冥王星、阋神星、妊神星、鸟神星和共工星。它于1978年由詹姆斯·克里斯蒂发现，的表面有许多撞击坑和冰山。

d1_0.en: Ceres, asteroid number 1, is the brightest object in the main asteroid belt between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter. Its diameter is approximately 945 kilometers, making it the largest asteroid within Neptune's orbit, ranking 35th in the list of solar system object sizes. It is the only object marked as a dwarf planet within Neptune's orbit, and also the only known object in the main asteroid belt to have achieved hydrostatic equilibrium. Ceres is composed of rock and ice, and it is estimated that its mass accounts for one third of the entire main asteroid belt. Due to its small volume, Ceres is rather dim, and it is difficult to observe Ceres on Earth without extremely dark night conditions.
d1_0.cn: 谷神星，小行星序号1，是火星和木星轨道之间的主小行星带中最亮的天体。它的直径大约是945千米，是海王星轨道以内最大的小行星，在太阳系天体大小列表排名第35，是在海王星轨道内唯一标示为矮行星的天体，也是主小行星带已知唯一自身达到流体静力平衡的天体。谷神星由岩石和冰组成，估计它的质量占整个主小行星带的三分之一。谷神星因其体积较小较为黯淡，若无极度昏暗的夜晚条件地球上也很难通过肉眼观察到谷神星。

d1_1.en: On January 1, 1801, the Italian Giuseppe Piazzi first discovered Ceres in Palermo, and named it after Demeter(Ceres), the Greek goddess of agriculture, grain, and maternal love (also one of the twelve main gods of Olympus). Ceres was initially considered a planet, but as more and more small objects were discovered on similar orbits, it was reclassified as an asteroid in the 1850s.
d1_1.cn: 1801年1月1日意大利人朱塞普·皮亚齐在巴勒莫首先发现了谷神星，并以希腊神话中司掌农业、谷物和母性之爱的地母神得墨忒耳（刻瑞斯）命名（也是奥林匹斯十二主神之一）。最初将谷神星当成行星，但在相似的轨道上发现越来越多小天体，其在1850年代重新归类为小行星。

d1_2.en: Gravitational data shows that there is differentiation within Ceres, including rock, core, and ice mantle, and there may be an internal ocean of liquid water beneath the ice layer.
d1_2.cn: 引力数据显示谷神星内部存在区分，分别为岩石、核和冰的地幔，冰层之下可能存在液态水的内部海洋。

d2_0.en: Pluto, asteroid number 134340, is a dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt of the solar system, named after the Roman god of the underworld. Pluto is the first discovered object in the Kuiper belt and is also the largest by volume and the second largest by mass among the known dwarf planets in the solar system. Among the objects directly orbiting the sun, Pluto ranks ninth in volume and tenth in mass.
d2_0.cn: 冥王星，小行星序号134340，是太阳系柯伊伯带中的矮行星，以罗马神话中的冥王，阴间的主宰命名。冥王星是第一颗被发现的柯伊伯带天体，也是太阳系内已知体积最大、质量第二大的矮行星。在直接围绕太阳运行的天体中，冥王星体积排名第九，质量排名第十。

d2_1.en: Pluto is the largest object beyond Neptune, with its mass second only to Eris in the scattered disc. Like other Kuiper belt objects, Pluto is primarily composed of rock and ice. Compared to the moon, Pluto has only one-sixth of the moon's mass and one-third of its volume. Pluto's orbit has a high eccentricity and inclination, with a perihelion of 30 astronomical units (4.4 billion kilometers) and an aphelion of 49 astronomical units (7.4 billion kilometers). As a result, Pluto periodically enters the inside of Neptune's orbit. Neptune and Pluto do not collide due to their mutual orbital resonance.
d2_1.cn: 冥王星是体积最大的海王星外天体，其质量仅次于位于离散盘中的阋神星。与其他柯伊伯带天体一样，冥王星主要由岩石和冰组成。相较月球，冥王星仅有月球质量的六分之一、月球体积的三分之一。冥王星的轨道离心率及倾角皆较高，近日点为30天文单位（44亿公里），远日点为49天文单位（74亿公里）。冥王星因此周期性进入海王星轨道内侧。海王星与冥王星因相互的轨道共振而不会碰撞。

d2_2.en: Clyde Tombaugh discovered Pluto in 1930 and considered it the ninth planet. After 1992, the discovery of some ice bodies in the Kuiper belt with masses comparable to Pluto challenged Pluto's planetary status. Eris, discovered in 2005, even has 27% more mass than Pluto, prompting the International Astronomical Union (IAU) to formally define the concept of a planet the following year. The new definition meant that Pluto was no longer listed as a planet, but was classified as a dwarf planet and a plutoid.
d2_2.cn: 1930年克莱德·汤博发现冥王星，并将其视为第九大行星。1992年后在柯伊伯带发现的一些质量与冥王星相若的冰制天体挑战了冥王星的行星地位，2005年发现的阋神星质量甚至比冥王星质量多出27%，国际天文联合会（IAU）因此在翌年正式定义行星概念。新定义使冥王星不再被列为一颗行星，而是归类为矮行星以及类冥天体。

d3_0.en: Haumea is a dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt, officially known as 136108 Haumea. Haumea is the third largest dwarf planet in the solar system, with a mass one-third that of Pluto.
d3_0.cn: 妊神星是柯伊伯带的一颗矮行星，正式名称为136108 Haumea。妊神星是太阳系的第三大矮行星，它的质量是冥王星质量的三分之一。

d3_1.en: In 2004, a team led by Michael E. Brown from the California Institute of Technology discovered this celestial body at the Palomar Observatory in the United States. On September 17, 2008, the International Astronomical Union (IAU) designated this celestial body as a dwarf planet and named it after Haumea, the Hawaiian goddess of fertility.
d3_1.cn: 2004年，迈克尔·E·布朗领导的加州理工学院团队在美国帕洛玛山天文台发现了该天体。2008年9月17日，国际天文联合会（IAU）将这颗天体定为矮行星，并以夏威夷生育之神哈乌美亚为其命名。

d3_2.en: Among all known dwarf planets, Haumea has a unique extreme deformation. Although its shape has not been directly observed, results calculated from the light curve suggest that Haumea is ellipsoidal, with its major axis twice the length of its minor axis. Despite this, it is estimated that its own gravity is still sufficient to maintain hydrostatic equilibrium, thus meeting the definition of a dwarf planet. Astronomers believe that Haumea's elongated shape, rare high-speed rotation, high density, and high albedo (due to its crystalline water ice surface) are the result of a super-collision.
d3_2.cn: 在所有的已知矮行星中，妊神星具有独特的极度形变。尽管人们尚未直接观测到它的形状，但由光变曲线计算的结果表明，妊神星呈椭球形，其长半轴是短半轴的两倍。尽管如此，据推算其自身重力仍足以维持流体静力平衡，因此符合矮行星的定义。天文学家认为，妊神星之所以具备形状伸长、罕见的高速自转、高密度和高反照率（因其结晶水冰的表面）这些特点，是超级碰撞的结果。

d4_0.en: Makemake, officially known as 136472 Makemake, is the fourth largest known dwarf planet in the solar system and one of the two largest in the classical Kuiper belt.
d4_0.cn: 鸟神星，正式名称为136472 Makemake，是太阳系内已知的第四大矮行星，亦是经典柯伊伯带天体中最大的两颗之一。

d4_1.en: The diameter of Makemake is about three-quarters that of Pluto, and it has one moon. The average temperature of Makemake is extremely low (about -230 °C), which means its surface is covered with methane and ethane, and there may also be solid nitrogen.
d4_1.cn: 鸟神星的直径大约是冥王星的四分之三，有一颗卫星。鸟神星的平均温度极低（约-230 °C），这意味着它的表面覆盖着甲烷与乙烷，并可能还存在固态氮。

d4_2.en: Makemake was discovered on March 31, 2005, by a team led by Michael E. Brown. To be consistent with the International Astronomical Union's (IAU) rules for naming classical Kuiper belt objects, Makemake was named after the creation deity Makemake (the creator of humanity and god of fertility in the mythology of the Rapa Nui, the native people of Easter Island).
d4_2.cn: 鸟神星是由迈克尔·E·布朗领导的团队在2005年3月31日发现的，为了与国际天文联合会（IAU）对经典柯伊伯带天体命名的规则相一致，鸟神星以创造之神马奇马奇（复活节岛拉帕努伊族原住民神话中的人类创造者与生殖之神）的名字来命名。

d4_3.en: On June 11, 2008, the IAU included Makemake in the list of candidates for plutoids. Plutoids are a specific classification for dwarf planets beyond Neptune's orbit, and at that time only Pluto and Eris belonged to this classification. In July 2008, Makemake was officially listed as a plutoid.
d4_3.cn: 2008年6月11日，国际天文联合会将鸟神星列入类冥天体的候选者名单内。类冥天体是海王星轨道外的矮行星的专属分类，当时只有冥王星和阋神星属于这个分类。2008年7月，鸟神星正式被列为类冥天体。

d5_0.en: Eris, asteroid number 136199 Eris, is the second largest known dwarf planet in the solar system and ranks ninth in mass among all bodies orbiting the Sun directly.
d5_0.cn: 阋神星，小行星序号136199 Eris，是现已知太阳系中第二大的矮行星，在所有直接围绕太阳运行的天体中质量排名第九。

d5_1.en: Its estimated diameter is about 2326±12 kilometers, about 27% heavier than Pluto (but Pluto has a slightly larger volume), and its mass is about 0.27% of the Earth's mass. It was discovered on January 5, 2005, by Michael Brown, Chad Trujillo, and David Rabinowitz from a stack of photos taken on October 21, 2003, and announced on July 29, 2005.
d5_1.cn: 它估测直径约为2326±12公里，比冥王星重约27%（但冥王星的体积更大一些），质量约为地球质量的0.27%。它由迈克尔·布朗、乍德·特鲁希略和大卫·拉比诺维茨在2005年1月5日，从一堆于2003年10月21日拍摄的相片中发现，并在2005年7月29日公布。

d5_2.en: Eris has a highly inclined orbit with a revolution period of 557 years, and it is classified as a scattered disc object (a celestial body deviating from the plane of the Earth's orbit). At the "26th International Astronomical Congress" in August 2006, Eris was included in the list of dwarf planets, assigned the asteroid number 136199, and named after Eris, the goddess of discord in Greek mythology. Because Eris appears to be larger than Pluto, its discoverers and NASA initially referred to it as the tenth largest planet in the solar system.
d5_2.cn: 阋神星的轨道极为倾斜，公转周期为557年，它被分类为黄道离散天体（偏离地球轨道平面的星体）。在2006年8月之“第26届国际天文学大会”上，把阋神星划入矮行星之列，赋与小行星编号136199号，并以希腊神话中的阋神（不和女神）厄里斯命名。因为阋神星看起来比冥王星要大，所以一开始它的发现者和NASA（美国国家太空总署） 把其称之为太阳系的第十大行星。

m1_0.en: Pallas (Asteroid No.2) is the first asteroid discovered by humans after Ceres (the only dwarf planet in the asteroid belt). Its estimated mass is 7% of the asteroid belt, with a diameter of 544 kilometers, slightly larger than Vesta, but its mass is 10-30% lighter than Vesta. Therefore, Pallas is the second heaviest asteroid in the asteroid belt and may also be the largest irregular celestial body in the solar system.
m1_0.cn: 智神星（小行星编号2）是人类继谷神星（小行星带中唯一的矮行星）后所发现的第一颗小行星。估计质量是小行星带的7%，直径为544千米，比灶神星稍大一些，但是其质量却比灶神星轻10–30%，所以智神星是小行星带中第二重的小行星，也可能是太阳系中最大的不规则天体。

m1_1.en: Pallas is named after Pallas, the daughter of the Greek sea god Triton, also known as Athena. Its surface appears to be composed of silicates. Pallas has an unusually high orbital inclination (up to 34.8°) and high eccentricity, similar to Pluto, making it difficult for spacecraft to visit Pallas.
m1_1.cn: 智神星是以希腊神话海神特里同的女儿帕拉斯（即雅典娜的别称）命名，它的表面似乎由硅酸盐组成。智神星有异常高的轨道倾角（高达34.8°）、高离心率，类似冥王星，所以太空船很难前往智神星拜访。

m2_0.en: Juno (Asteroid No.3) is the third asteroid discovered by humans and one of the largest asteroids in the asteroid belt. It is an S-type asteroid composed of heavier rock. It was discovered by German astronomer Karl Ludwig Harding using a regular 2-inch aperture telescope on September 1, 1804, and named after Juno, the highest-ranking goddess of marriage in Roman mythology.
m2_0.cn: 婚神星（小行星编号3）是人类发现的第三颗小行星，也是小行星带中最大的小行星之一，是由较重的石质组成的S-型小行星。它在1804年9月1日被德国天文学家卡尔·路德维希·哈丁以一架普通的2英寸口径望远镜发现的，以罗马神话中位阶最高的婚姻之神朱诺来命名。

m2_1.en: Spectral studies show that the surface of Juno contains components of chondritic meteorites, as well as iron silicates found in ordinary stone meteorites, such as olivine and pyroxene, which may be the source of chondritic meteorites. On October 2, 2001, at local noon, the measured surface maximum temperature was about 293K, which can be converted to a temperature of 301K (28°C) at the perihelion position in heliocentric coordinates.
m2_1.cn: 光谱研究显示婚神星表面含球粒陨石的成分，以及普通的石陨石中都有的含铁硅酸盐，像是橄榄石和辉石等，可能是球粒陨石的来源。在2001年10月2日于日正当中时，测得的表面最高温度约为293K，换算可得在日心座标的近日点位置时温度可以达到301K（28℃）。

m3_0.en: Vesta (Asteroid number 4) is one of the largest bodies in the main asteroid belt, with an average diameter of 525 kilometers. It was discovered by Heinrich Olbers on March 29, 1807, and named after Vesta, the goddess of home and hearth in Roman mythology, translated into Chinese as the Kitchen God in Chinese mythology. Vesta is the largest main belt asteroid in mass after the dwarf planet Ceres, accounting for 9% of the total mass of the main asteroid belt. Although it has a larger mass than Pallas, its volume is smaller, making it the second largest asteroid in volume.
m3_0.cn: 灶神星（小行星编号4）为主小行星带中体积最大的天体之一，平均直径525千米。它是海因里希·奥伯斯在1807年3月29日发现，以罗马神话中家和壁炉的女神Vesta命名，中文翻译为中国神话中的灶神。灶神星是继矮行星谷神星之后，质量最大的主带小行星，占有主小行星带总质量的9%。虽然质量比智神星多，但体积却比较小，是体积第二大的小行星。

m3_1.en: Vesta is the brightest asteroid visible from Earth. Its farthest distance from the sun is only a little farther than Ceres' closest distance, but Vesta's orbit is entirely within Ceres' orbit. NASA's Dawn spacecraft entered orbit around Vesta from July 16, 2011, to September 5, 2012, conducting nearly a year of exploration before heading to Ceres.
m3_1.cn: 灶神星是从地球可以看见的最亮的小行星，它距离太阳最远时的距离只比谷神星最近的距离远了一点，不过灶神星的轨道完全都在谷神星的轨道之内。NASA的黎明号航天器在2011年7月16日至2012年9月5日进入环绕灶神星的轨道，进行了将近一年的探测，然后前往谷神星。

m4_0.en: Varuna is a large Kuiper Belt object, officially named 20000 Varuna. It was discovered by American astronomer Robert McMillan in 2000 in Arizona, USA, and is one of the dwarf planet candidates.
m4_0.cn: 伐楼拿是一颗巨大的柯伊伯带天体，正式名称是：20000 Varuna，由美国天文学家麦克米伦于2000年在美国亚利桑那州发现，是矮行星的候选者之一。

m4_1.en: Varuna is the god of the sky, rain, and celestial ocean in Indian mythology, and he also governs laws and the underworld. Little is known about its detailed information at present, and it can only be inferred from astronomical telescopes that its diameter is about 1060 kilometers.
m4_1.cn: 伐楼拿是印度神话中天空，雨水及天海之神，他亦是掌管法规与阴间的神。关于其详细消息现在知道得很少，只能从天文望远镜中推测其直径约为1060公里。

m5_0.en: xion is a Kuiper belt object discovered on May 22, 2001, with the asteroid number 28978. Its orbital resonance with Neptune is 3:2, so it is classified as a Plutino. Although the International Astronomical Union (IAU) believes that the existing data cannot determine it as a dwarf planet, this celestial body is likely to be recognized as a Plutino dwarf planet in the future.
m5_0.cn: 伊克西翁是一柯伊伯带天体，于2001年5月22日被发现，小行星编号为28978。它与海王星的轨道共振为3:2，因此被分类为冥族小天体。虽然国际天文学联合会（IAU）认为现有的数据未能确定其为矮行星，但该天体将来很有可能被认定为类冥矮行星。

m5_1.en: This celestial body is named after Ixion, the arrogant king of the Lapiths in Greek mythology. Its diameter is about 650 kilometers, making it the fifth largest Plutino. It appears moderately red in visible light and has a surface made of a mixture of tholins and water ice.
m5_1.cn: 该天体以希腊神话中狂妄的拉皮斯人国王伊克西翁来命名。它的直径约为650公里，是第五大的冥族小天体。它在可见光下呈中度红色，并具有由托林和水冰混合物制成的表面。

m6_0.en: Quaoar is a traditional Kuiper belt object and a candidate dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt. According to astronomers' estimates, Quaoar has a diameter of about 1110 kilometers, half that of Pluto. On June 6, 2002, American astronomers Brown and Trujillo discovered this celestial body at the Palomar Mountain Observatory. Signs of water ice have been found on Quaoar, indicating that it may have cryovolcanic activity.
m6_0.cn: 创神星是一颗传统柯伊伯带天体，亦是柯伊伯带的候选矮行星。根据天文学家估计，创神星直径大约为1110公里，是冥王星的一半。2002年6月6日，美国天文学家布朗和特鲁希略于帕洛马山天文台发现这个天体。现时已经发现创神星上有水冰的迹象，表示其可能有冰火山活动。

m6_1.en: Quaoar and its moon are named after mythological figures from the Tongva tribe of Native Americans in Southern California. Quaoar is the creation god of the Tongva tribe, and Weywot (Quaoar I) is his son.
m6_1.cn: 创神星及其卫星都是以位于南加州的美洲原住民通格瓦部族的神话人物命名。夸欧尔是通格瓦族的创世之神，维沃特（创卫一）则是他的儿子。

m7_0.en: Orcus is a celestial body in the Kuiper belt, temporarily numbered as 2004 DW when it was discovered. It is a typical Plutino (having a 2:3 orbital resonance with Neptune), with an orbit shape similar to Pluto's (both of their perihelia are above the ecliptic), only pointing in different directions. However, having the same resonance with Neptune makes it unnaturally always in the phase opposite to Pluto; so Orcus is sometimes described as the anti-Pluto.
m7_0.cn: 亡神星是柯伊伯带的天体，被发现时的临时编号为2004 DW。它是一颗典型的类冥天体（与海王星有2：3轨道共振关系），轨道的形状与冥王星相似（两者的近日点都在黄道上方），只是指向的方向不同。然而与海王星有着相同的共振使它很不自然的总在与冥王星相对的相位上；所以亡神星有时会被描述为反冥王星。

m7_1.en: According to the naming convention of the International Astronomical Union, Plutinos should be named after gods of the underworld in mythology. The discoverers suggested naming it after the god of the dead in ancient Roman Etruscan mythology, and on November 22, 2004, they received approval from the naming committee, officially naming it Orcus.
m7_1.cn: 依据国际天文联合会的命名惯例，与类冥小天体应该以神话中冥府的神来命名。发现者建议以古罗马伊特鲁里亚神话的亡者之神为名，并且在2004年11月22日获得命名委员会的同意，正式命名为奥迦斯（Orcus）。

m8_0.en: Chariklo is the largest confirmed centaur asteroid (small celestial bodies in the outer solar system). It orbits the Sun between Saturn and Uranus and sweeps across the orbit of Uranus. On March 26, 2014, astronomers announced the discovery of two planetary rings through the observation of stellar occultation, making it the first known asteroid with rings.
m8_0.cn: 女凯龙星是确认的最大的半人马小行星（外太阳系的小天体）。它在土星和天王星之间绕着太阳运行，并会掠过天王星轨道。在2014年3月26日，天文学家宣布通过观测恒星掩星，发现了两个行星环，使它成为第一颗已知有环的小行星。它以宁芙查理洛命名，是凯龙（希腊神话中的贤者，半人马喀戎）的妻子和阿波罗的女儿。

m8_1.en: It is named after Chariclo, the wife of Chiron (a wise figure in Greek mythology, the centaur Chiron) and the daughter of Apollo. Chariklo is currently the largest known centaur asteroid, and it may qualify as a dwarf planet, with an equivalent diameter of about 250 kilometers, and its shape may be elongated.
m8_1.cn: 女凯龙星是现时已知最大的半人马小行星，它可能有资格成为一颗矮行星，体积当量直径约为250公里，形状可能是细长的。

m9_0.en: Hygiea is located in the asteroid belt and is a major asteroid. By volume and mass, it is the fourth largest asteroid in the solar system. In some spectral classifications, it is the largest of the dim C-type asteroids with a carbonaceous surface, on the other hand, it ranks second, only to Ceres.
m9_0.cn: 健神星位于主带，是一颗主要的小行星。按体积和质量划分，它是太阳系中第四大的小行星。在一些光谱分类中，它是表面是碳的黯淡C型小行星中最大的，另一方面，它排名第二，仅次于谷神星。

m9_1.en: Observations in October 2019 announced that Hygiea has an almost spherical shape, which at least conforms to hydrostatic equilibrium, so it also has the potential to qualify as a dwarf planet. Its name comes from the Greek goddess of health, Hygieia (the daughter of the god of medicine, Asclepius).
m9_1.cn: 在2019年10月的观测中宣布健神星有一个几乎是球体的形状，这至少符合流体静力平衡，因此它也有潜在资格成为一颗矮行星。它的名字来自希腊神话健康女神许癸厄亚（医神阿斯克勒庇俄斯之女）。

m10_0.en: Salacia (Asteroid No.120347) is a trans-Neptunian object with an orbital radius slightly larger than Pluto's. With a diameter of about 850 kilometers, it is a larger asteroid orbiting the sun and is considered a potential dwarf planet.
m10_0.cn: 漾神星（小行星编号120347）是一颗海王星外天体，轨道半径略微大于冥王星。其直径约为850公里，是一颗较大的绕日小星体，被认为有可能成为一颗矮行星。

m10_1.en: The International Astronomical Union officially named it Salacia on February 18, 2011. In Roman mythology, Salacia is the wife of Neptune, equivalent to Amphitrite in Greek mythology.
m10_1.cn: 国际天文学会于2011年2月18日将其正式命名为Salacia（萨拉喀亚），她是罗马神话中尼普顿（海王）的妻子，即希腊神话中的安菲特里忒。

m11_0.en: Huya (asteroid 38628, 2000 EB173) is a trans-Neptunian object discovered by Ignacio Ferrin on March 10, 2000. In August 2003, the International Astronomical Union officially named it Huya, after the rain god in South American Indian mythology.
m11_0.cn: 雨神星（小行星38628，2000 EB173）是一个外海王星天体，2000年3月10日由伊格纳西奥·费瑞恩发现，2003年8月国际天文联会正式命名为Huya（南美洲印第安神话中的雨神）。

m11_1.en: This celestial body has a 3:2 orbital resonance with Neptune, so it is classified as a plutino.
m11_1.cn: 该天体与海王星的轨道共振为3:2，因此被分类为冥族小天体。

m12_0.en: Albion is named after Albion, the primordial giant in the mythology of William Blake. It is the first trans-Neptunian object discovered after Pluto and Charon (Pluto's moon), with the minor planet number 15760.Since its discovery, it has become representative of the main category of QB1 objects in the Kuiper Belt.
m12_0.cn: Albion是以威廉·布莱克神话中的原始巨人阿尔比恩命名的。它是继冥王星与卡戎（冥卫一）之后，被发现的第一颗外海王星天体，小编号为15760。在其被发现之后已经成为柯伊伯带中主要类别QB1天体的代表。

m12_1.en: This asteroid is named after Albion from the mythology written by English poet and painter William Blake. The name Albion originates from an ancient name for Great Britain, and is the oldest known name for the island.
m12_1.cn: 这个小行星以英国诗人和画家威廉·布莱克所著神话中的阿尔比恩命名。阿尔比恩这个名字源于大不列颠岛的古称，也是该岛已知最古老的名称。

m13_0.en: Gonggong, located in the scattered disc, is a trans-Neptunian object with a diameter of approximately 1500 kilometers and is known to have one moon. Gonggong is the third largest known trans-Neptunian object, slightly larger than Haumea or Makemake, so it can almost be considered a dwarf planet. In 2020, it was named "Gonggong", after the water god in Chinese mythology, and its moon (Gonggong I) was named after Xiangliu, a subordinate of Gonggong.
m13_0.cn: 共工星，是位于离散盘内的海王星外天体，直径约1500公里，已知其拥有一颗卫星。共工星在已知的海王星外天体中体积第三大，稍微大于鸟神星或妊神星，因此它几乎可被认为是矮行星。2020年其获命名为“共工星”，即中国神话中的水神，其卫星（共卫一）则以共工的臣属相柳命名。

m13_1.en: In 2019, its discoverers initiated an online vote, proposing three alternative names: "Gonggong" from Chinese culture, "Holle" from German culture, and "Vili" from Norse culture. All three mythological characters are associated with water, ice, snow, and the color red, which are characteristics of the celestial body, and all have related character names that can be used for its moon. The discovery team collected 280,000 votes to get the result, and the name "Gonggong" from Chinese mythology received 46% of the votes, becoming the final name.
m13_1.cn: 2019年，其发现者发起线上投票，提出三个备选名称：来自中国文化的“共工”、来自德国文化的“霍勒”，和来自北欧文化的“维利”。三个神话角色都与水、冰雪和红色相关，符合天体的特征，也都有与之相关的角色名可以用于其卫星。发现者团队收集了28万份投票得出结果，中国神话中的水神名称“共工”获得46%的投票，成为最终的名称。

m14_0.en: Sedna (asteroid number 90377) is a trans-Neptunian object that was jointly discovered by astronomers Brown, Trujillo, and Rabinowitz on November 14, 2003. At the time of its discovery, it was the farthest large natural object from Earth in the solar system. Its orbit is a highly eccentric ellipse, with an estimated aphelion of 937 astronomical units, making it one of the most distant objects in the solar system, further than most long-period comets.
m14_0.cn: 赛德娜（小行星编号90377）为一颗外海王星天体，它于2003年11月14日由天文学家布朗、特鲁希略及拉比诺维茨共同发现，它被发现时是太阳系中距离地球最远的大型天然天体，公转轨道是一个离心率较大的椭圆，远日点估计为937天文单位，所以它是太阳系中最遥远的天体之一，比大部分的长周期彗星都还要远。

m14_1.en: Sedna is currently 88 astronomical units from the sun, three times the distance between Neptune and the sun. For most of Sedna's orbital period, its distance from the sun is greater than any known dwarf planet candidate. The International Astronomical Union has not currently classified Sedna as a dwarf planet, but some astronomers believe it should be considered one.
m14_1.cn: 赛德娜目前距离太阳88天文单位，为海王星与太阳之间距离的3倍。在赛德娜大部分的公转周期中，它与太阳之间的距离比任何已知的矮行星候选都要遥远。国际天文学联合会目前并未将赛德娜视为矮行星，但是有一些天文学家认为它应该是一颗矮行星。

c1_0.en: Halley's Comet is a famous short-period comet that can be observed from Earth every 75-76 years. It is the only short-period comet that can be directly seen from Earth with the naked eye, and a person may experience its visit twice in a lifetime. Other comets that can be observed with the naked eye may be more spectacular and beautiful, but they may only appear once in thousands of years.
c1_0.cn: 哈雷彗星是有名的短周期彗星，每隔75-76年就能从地球上被观测到，亦是唯一能用肉眼直接从地球看到的短周期彗星，人的一生中可能经历两次其来访。其他能以肉眼观察到的彗星可能会更壮观和美丽，但可能要数千年才会出现一次。

c1_1.en: At least as early as 240 BC, or even earlier in 466 BC, the return of Halley's Comet to the inner solar system was observed and recorded by astronomers. Clear records of this comet's appearance exist in China, Babylon, and medieval Europe, but the observers at the time did not know that this was the reappearance of the same comet. British astronomer Edmund Halley was the first to estimate its period using Kepler's third law, and the comet was named Halley's Comet when it returned in 1758-1759.
c1_1.cn: 至少在公元前240年，或在更早的公元前466年，哈雷彗星返回内太阳系就已经由天文学家观测和记录到。在华夏、巴比伦和中世纪的欧洲都有这颗彗星出现的清楚记录，但是当时的观测者并不知道这是同一颗彗星的再出现。英国天文学家爱德蒙·哈雷最先使用开普勒第三定律估算出他的周期，1758-1759年彗星再次来临的时候，这颗彗星被命名为哈雷彗星。

c1_2.en: Halley's Comet is a mixture of volatile ices - water, carbon dioxide, and ammonia - and cosmic dust. The last return of Halley's Comet was in 1986, and the next return will be around 2061.
c1_2.cn: 哈雷彗星是挥发性冰——水、二氧化碳、和氨－和宇宙尘埃的混合物。哈雷彗星上一次回归在1986年，而下一次回归将大约在2061年。

c2_0.en: Encke is the representative of the Encke-type comets and is the second comet to return as predicted after Halley's Comet. Its perihelion and aphelion are about 0.36AU and 4.1AU respectively, with an eccentricity of 0.8474 and a period of 3.2984 years. It has the shortest period of all comets, with weak brightness, low cohesiveness, and generally does not produce a comet tail.
c2_0.cn: 恩克是恩克族彗星的代表，也是继哈雷彗星之后，第二颗按预言回归的彗星。其近日点和远日点分别约为0.36AU和4.1AU，离心率0.8474，周期3.2984年，是所有彗星中周期最短的，亮度微弱，凝聚度较小，一般不产生彗尾。

c2_1.en: Encke's Comet is the parent comet of the Taurid meteor shower, which peaks in October/November each year. They are fast and famous for their fireballs. Typically, this special meteor shower appears around Halloween, hence it is referred to as the Halloween Fireballs.
c2_1.cn: 恩克彗星是金牛座流星雨的母彗星，该流星雨在每年的10月/11月达到顶峰，它们速度很快，以火球而闻名。通常，这种特殊的流星雨会在万圣节前后出现，因此被称为万圣节火球。

c3_0.en: The Faye Comet was discovered by Faye on November 25, 1843, at the Royal Observatory in Paris, France. In 1844, after calculations by astronomers, it was determined that the Faye Comet is a short-period comet.
c3_0.cn: 法叶彗星由法叶于1843年11月25日在法国巴黎的皇家天文台所发现。 在1844年间，经过天文学家的计算后，确定法叶彗星为短周期彗星。

c3_1.en: During its return on May 6, 1999, the comet's maximum brightness only reached the 13th magnitude. On November 15, 2006, the Faye Comet returned again, with a maximum brightness of approximately the 8th magnitude.
c3_1.cn: 1999年5月6日的回归，彗星的最大亮度只有达到13等。2006年11月15日法叶彗星再度回归，最大亮度约为8等。

c4_0.en: This comet was discovered by Heinrich Louis d'Arrest on June 28, 1851, in the constellation Pisces. Its luminosity was very dim when it was discovered, and it was not visible the next day due to the hazy weather, but on June 30, d'Arrest described it as a large and dim comet.
c4_0.cn: 这颗彗星是海因里希·路易·达雷于1851年6月28日在双鱼座发现的。他被发现时的光度非常暗淡，第二天因为天气过于朦胧，因此未能见到，但在6月30日达雷描述这是一颗大而暗淡的彗星。

c5_0.en: Jean Louis Pons first discovered this comet on June 12, 1819, in Marseille, France. Then, on March 9, 1858, Friedrich Winnecke rediscovered it in Bonn, Germany.
c5_0.cn: 尚·路易斯·庞士在1819年6月12日首度在法国马赛发现这颗彗星，然后，在1858年3月9日，弗里德里希·温尼克在德国波昂再度发现这颗彗星。

c5_1.en: This comet is considered to be the parent body of the June Bootids meteor shower that occurs in late June.
c5_1.cn: 这颗彗星被认为是6月下旬的6月牧夫座流星雨的母体。

c6_0.en: The Tuttle Comet is a periodic comet in the solar system, and observers in the northern hemisphere can see this comet near the North Star with a small telescope. It will pass by Earth at a distance of 0.25 astronomical units on January 2, 2008, and became a favorite for observers in the southern hemisphere a month later.
c6_0.cn: 塔特尔彗星是一颗太阳系内的周期彗星，北半球的观测者可以用小望远镜在北极星附近看见这颗彗星。它曾在2008年1月2日以0.25天文单位的距离掠过地球，之后的一个月成为了南半球观测者的最爱。

c6_1.en: It is the parent comet of the Ursids meteor shower in late December, and the Ursids meteor shower in 2007 was quite spectacular due to its return.
c6_1.cn: 它是12月下旬小熊座流星雨的母彗星，2007年的小熊座流星雨因为它的回归而较为壮观。

c7_0.en: The Tempel 1 Comet is a periodic comet, which, at the time of discovery, approached perihelion once every 5.68 years.
c7_0.cn: 坦普尔1号彗星是一颗周期彗星，当初在发现时，坦普尔1号彗星每5.68年内接近一次近日点。

c7_1.en: It is not a bright comet; its maximum magnitude is about +11, far below the range visible to the naked eye. After observations with the Hubble Space Telescope using visible light and the Spitzer Space Telescope's infrared, its size is believed to be approximately 14x4 kilometers. These observations also found that its albedo is only 4%, with a rotation period of two days.
c7_1.cn: 它并非是一颗明亮的彗星；其最大星等大约为+11，远远低于裸眼可视范围。经由哈勃天文望远镜使用可见光和史匹哲太空望远镜的红外线观测后，其大小据信约为14x4千米。这些观测也发现其反照率只有4%，自转周期为两日。

c8_0.en: The Tempel 2 Comet is a periodic Jupiter-family comet with an orbital period of 5 years. It was discovered by Wilhelm Tempel on July 4, 1873.
c8_0.cn: 坦普尔二号彗星，是一颗周期性木星族彗星，轨道周期为5年。它是由威廉·坦普尔于1873年7月4日发现。

c8_1.en: Its next perihelion passage is on August 2, 2026, at which time the comet's solar elongation will reach 164 degrees, with an apparent magnitude of about 8. The closest approach to Earth is a day later on August 3, 2026, at a distance of 0.414 astronomical units (61.9 million kilometers).
c8_1.cn: 它下一次经过近日点是2026年8月2日，届时彗星的太阳距角将达到164度，视星等约为8等。最接近地球的时间是一天后的2026年8月3日，距离为0.414天文单位（6190 万公里）。

c9_0.en: The Tempel-Swift-LINEAR comet was initially discovered by Tempel in Marseille on November 2, 1869. Then, Lewis Swift discovered a comet at the Warner Observatory on October 11, 1880, which was determined to be the same comet.
c9_0.cn: 坦普尔-斯威夫特-林尼尔彗星最初是坦普尔在马赛于1869年11月2日发现的。然后，路易斯·斯威夫特在沃纳天文台于1880年10月11日发现了一颗彗星，并被认定是同一颗彗星。

c9_1.en: From 1908 onwards, this comet was no longer observed, but on December 7, 2001, an object imaged on September 10 and October 17 by the Lincoln Near-Earth Asteroid Research (LINEAR) was confirmed to be this missing comet.
c9_1.cn: 从1908年起，这颗彗星就未曾再被观测到，但是在2001年12月7日，林肯近地小行星搜寻计划（缩写LINEAR的中文发音为林尼尔）发现在9月10日和10月17日观测到的一个天体影像，被证实就是这颗消失的彗星。

c10_0.en: The Pons-Brooks Comet is a comet with an orbital period of 71 years. It fits the classic definition of Halley's Comet and is also one of the brightest known periodic comets, reaching an absolute magnitude of 5 when approaching perihelion.
c10_0.cn: 庞士-布鲁克斯彗星是一颗轨道周期71年的彗星。它符合哈雷彗星的经典定义，也是最亮的已知周期彗星之一，在接近近日点时达到绝对视星等5。

c10_1.en: The next time it passes perihelion is on April 21, 2024, at a distance of 1.55 AU, and it is estimated that the apparent magnitude of this comet can reach 4.5 at that time.
c10_1.cn: 下一次通过近日点的时间是2024年4月21日，距离1.55AU，预估这颗彗星届时的视星等可以达到4.5等。

c11_0.en: This comet was discovered by Olbers in Bremen, Germany, on March 6, 1815. Its orbit was first calculated by Carl Friedrich Gauss on March 31. Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel calculated its orbital period to be 73.9 Julian years, while other astronomers calculated results between 72 and 77 Julian years.
c11_0.cn: 奥伯斯在1815年3月6日在德国的不来梅发现这颗彗星，它的轨道最早是由卡尔·弗里德里希·高斯在3月31日算出的，弗里德里希·威廉·贝塞尔算出它的轨道周期为73.9儒略年，而其它的天文学佳算出的结果则介于72和77儒略年之间。

c11_1.en: The comet last returned in 1956, and its next return is in 2024, but the closest approach to Earth will be on January 10, 2094.
c11_1.cn: 这颗彗星上次是在1956年回归，下次的回归是2024年，但在2094年1月10将是最接近地球的时刻。

c12_0.en: This comet was discovered by Max Wolf on September 17, 1884, in Heidelberg, Germany. Initially, the perihelion of this comet was 2.74 astronomical units, with a period of 8.84 Julian years.
c12_0.cn: 马克斯·沃夫于1884年9月17日在德国的海德堡发现这颗彗星。起初，这颗彗星的近日点是2.74天文单位，周期为8.84儒略年。

c12_1.en: However, after passing Jupiter at a distance of 0.125 astronomical units on September 27, 1922, the perihelion changed to 2.43 astronomical units, and the period changed to 8.28 Julian years.
c12_1.cn: 但在1922年9月27日以0.125天文单位的距离掠过木星之后，近日点变为2.43天文单位，周期则变为8.28儒略年。

c13_0.en: The Finlay Comet was discovered by South African astronomer William Henry Finlay at the Royal Observatory at the Cape of Good Hope in South Africa on September 26, 1886. The brightness of this comet began to decline after 1926, so it disappeared for a while and was not observed again until each return in 1953.
c13_0.cn: 芬利彗星在1886年9月26日被南非天文学家威廉·亨利·芬利在位于南非好望角的皇家天文台发现。这颗彗星的亮度在1926年之后开始下降，因此失踪了一段时间，直到1953年才再度观测到每一次的回归。

c13_1.en: On December 6, 2014, the comet erupted, increasing its brightness from 11 to 9, making it observable with a 50mm binocular telescope. After sunset on December 23, the comet appeared in the sky accompanied by Mars, only 1/6 degree apart, but its brightness was lower than when it first erupted.
c13_1.cn: 2014年12月6日该彗星爆发，亮度从11提高到9等以至可以用50mm口径双筒望远镜进行观测，12月23日日落后该彗星和火星在天空中相伴出现，相隔仅1/6度，但亮度已比刚爆发时低。

c13_2.en: It is estimated that on December 26, 2060, 15P/Finlay will pass from a distance of 0.047 astronomical units from Earth.
c13_2.cn: 预计2060年12月26日15P/Finlay将从距地球0.047天文单位处经过。

c14_0.en: The Brooks Comet was discovered by William Robert Brooks on July 7, 1889, as a periodic comet that showed no signs of movement. It was not until the next morning when he saw the comet had moved north that he confirmed this discovery.
c14_0.cn: 布鲁克斯彗星是威廉·罗伯特·布鲁克斯在1889年7月7日发现，但未注意到任何运动的一颗周期彗星。他在第二天的早晨看见彗星已经北移，才证实了此一发现。

c14_1.en: The comet fragmented when it passed Jupiter in 1886 due to its proximity to the Roche limit, and it operated within Io's orbit for two days. Since its discovery, the magnitude of this comet has dropped by 2 each time, and no new fragments have been discovered since 1889.
c14_1.cn: 该彗星在1886年行经木星时因靠近洛希极限而碎裂，它在艾欧的轨道之内运行了两天。自从发现之后，这颗彗星的星等每次都降低2等，并且在1889年之后就未再发现新的碎片。

c15_0.en: The Holmes Comet was first discovered by British astronomer Edwin Holmes on November 6, 1892. In October 2007, its magnitude skyrocketed from 17 to about 2.8 within 42 hours. This change equates to an increase in luminosity by 500,000 times, making it the most famous erupting comet.
c15_0.cn: 霍姆斯彗星，于1892年11月6日首度被英国天文学家埃德温·霍姆斯发现。在2007年10月，它的星等在42小时内由17等爆增至约2.8等。这个变化相当于增加了50万倍的光度，并且成为最有名的爆发彗星。

c15_1.en: On November 9, 2007, the diameter of the comet's coma exceeded that of the sun, making it the largest object in the solar system.
c15_1.cn: 在2007年11月9日，这颗彗星的彗发直径超过了太阳，成为太阳系内最巨大的天体。

c16_0.en: The Borrelly Comet is a periodic comet that was visited by the Deep Space 1 spacecraft. This comet was discovered on December 28, 1904, during Alphonse Borrelly's regular comet patrol in Marseille, France.
c16_0.cn: 包瑞利彗星是一颗周期彗星，深太空1号太空船曾经拜访的彗星。这颗彗星是在阿方斯·包瑞利在法国马赛进行定期的彗星巡视时，在1904年12月28日发现的。

c17_0.en: The Hale-Bopp Comet is a long-period comet that was jointly discovered by two American amateur astronomers in 1995 and passed its perihelion on April 1, 1997. Compared to Halley's Comet, if the two comets were placed on the same orbit, the brightness of the Hale-Bopp Comet would exceed the former by a thousand times.
c17_0.cn: 海尔-波普彗星是一颗长周期彗星，于1995年由两位美国业余天文学家共同发现，于1997年4月1日过近日点。与哈雷彗星比较，若把两颗彗星放在同一轨道上，海尔-波普彗星的亮度会超过前者千倍。

c17_1.en: While comets are usually inconspicuous beyond Jupiter's orbit, the Hale-Bopp Comet is an exception. When the comet passed its perihelion, its luminosity was -1.4 magnitude, visible even in cities. It was the brightest comet since 1975, making it one of the most spectacular comets in the past two decades. According to images from the Hubble Space Telescope, the diameter of the Hale-Bopp Comet is estimated to be about 40 kilometers, making it a large comet.
c17_1.cn: 通常彗星在木星轨道外会比较不显眼，但海尔-波普彗星则例外，该彗星过近日点时光度为-1.4等，纵使在城市中亦能以肉眼看见，是自1975年最亮的彗星，因此它成为了近二十年来最壮观的彗星之一。根据哈勃空间望远镜的影像，海尔-波普彗星的直径估计约40公里，属于大型彗星。

c17_2.en: The appearance of the Hale-Bopp Comet also caused some panic. As of January 2006, Japanese astronomy enthusiasts in Australia were still capturing images of the comet; preliminary calculations suggest that the Hale-Bopp Comet will return in over two thousand years.
c17_2.cn: 海尔-波普彗星的出现也引起了一些恐慌。直至2006年1月仍有日本天文爱好者在澳大利亚拍摄到该彗星的身影；经初步计算，海尔-波普彗星于二千多年后会回归。

mb_0.en: The Asteroid Belt is a dense area of asteroids in the solar system, located between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter. Of the 120,437 numbered asteroids, 98.5% were discovered here.
mb_0.cn: 小行星带是太阳系内介于火星和木星轨道之间的小行星密集区域。在已经被编号的120437颗小行星中，有98.5%是在这里被发现的。

mb_1.en: Asteroids are small celestial bodies made of rock or metal that orbit the sun. Because this is the densest region of asteroids (estimated to be as many as 500,000), this area is referred to as the Main Asteroid Belt, or simply "the Main Belt".
mb_1.cn: 小行星是由岩石或金属组成，围绕着太阳运动的小天体。因为在这里是小行星最密集的区域（估计为数多达50万颗），所以这个区域被称为主小行星带，简称“主带”。

mb_2.en: The Asteroid Belt was formed from a group of planetesimals - precursors to planets that are smaller than planets - from the primitive solar nebula. The huge gravity of Jupiter prevented these planetesimals from forming planets and caused many high-energy collisions between them, resulting in many remnants and fragments.
mb_2.cn: 小行星带由原始太阳星云中的一群星子——比行星微小的行星前身——形成。木星巨大的引力阻碍了这些星子形成行星，并造成许多星子相互间高能量的碰撞，造成许多残骸和碎片。

mb_3.en: The first three asteroids found in the Main Belt were Ceres, Pallas, and Vesta, while the three largest asteroids are Ceres, Vesta, and Hygiea, all with an average diameter of over 400 kilometers. There is only one dwarf planet in the Main Belt - Ceres, with a diameter of about 950 kilometers; the rest of the asteroids are not large, some are even only the size of dust.
mb_3.cn: 主带内最早发现的三颗小行星是智神星、婚神星和灶神星，而最大的三颗小行星则为智神星、健神星和灶神星，它们的平均直径都超过400公里；在主带中只有一颗矮行星——谷神星，直径大约950公里；其余的小行星都不大，有的甚至只有尘埃大小。

mb_4.en: The material in the Asteroid Belt is very sparse, and several spacecraft have safely passed through without incident. The asteroids within the Main Belt are divided into three categories according to their color and main form: C-type (carbonaceous), S-type (silicate), and M-type (metallic).
mb_4.cn: 小行星带的物质非常稀薄，已经有好几艘太空船平安的通过而未曾发生意外。在主带内的小行星依照它们的色彩和主要形式分成三类：C-型（碳质）、S-型（硅酸盐）和M-型（金属）。

kb_0.en: The Kuiper Belt is a dense, disc-shaped region of celestial bodies located near the ecliptic plane, outside the orbit of Neptune in the solar system (about 30 astronomical units from the Sun). The hypothesis of the Kuiper Belt was first proposed by American astronomer Frederick Leonard, and was confirmed by Gerard Kuiper a decade later.
kb_0.cn: 柯伊伯带是位于太阳系的海王星轨道（距离太阳约30天文单位）外侧，在黄道面附近的天体密集圆盘状区域。柯伊伯带的假说最先由美国天文学家弗雷德里克·伦纳德提出，十几年后杰拉德·柯伊伯证实了该观点。

kb_1.en: The Kuiper Belt is similar to the asteroid belt, but much larger, being 20 times wider and 20 to 200 times heavier than the asteroid belt. Like the main asteroid belt, it mainly contains small bodies or remnants of the formation of the solar system. While most asteroids are primarily composed of rock and metal, most objects in the Kuiper Belt are largely composed of frozen volatiles (known as "ices"), such as methane, ammonia, and water.
kb_1.cn: 柯伊伯带类似于小行星带，但范围大得多，它比小行星带宽20倍且重20至200倍。如同主小行星带，它主要包含小天体或太阳系形成的遗迹。虽然大多数小行星主要是岩石和金属构成的，但大部分柯伊伯带天体在很大程度上由冷冻的挥发成分（称为“冰”），如甲烷、氨和水组成。

kb_2.en: The Kuiper Belt contains at least four dwarf planets: Pluto, Haumea, Makemake, and Eris. Some moons in the solar system, such as Neptune's Triton and Saturn's Phoebe, are also thought to originate from this region.
kb_2.cn: 柯伊伯带至少有四颗矮行星：冥王星、妊神星、鸟神星和阋神星。一些太阳系中的卫星，如海王星的海卫一和土星的土卫九，也被认为起源于该区域。

kb_3.en: The Kuiper Belt is located on a low-inclination orbit 40 to 50 astronomical units from the Sun. This area was once thought to be empty and the end of the solar system. But in fact, it is filled with icy micro-asteroids ranging in diameter from a few kilometers to thousands of kilometers. The origin and exact structure of the Kuiper Belt are not yet clear. The current theory speculates that it originated from fragments on the solar protoplanetary disk. These fragments attracted and collided with each other, but ultimately only formed a micro-asteroid belt instead of a planet, and the solar wind and matter slow down here.
kb_3.cn: 柯伊伯带的位置处于距离太阳40至50天文单位的低倾角轨道上。该处过去一直被认为空无一物，是太阳系的尽头所在。但事实上这里满布着直径从数公里到上千公里的冰封微行星。柯伊伯带的起源和确实结构尚未明确，目前的理论推测是其来源于太阳原行星盘上的碎片，这些碎片相互吸引碰撞，但最后只组成了微行星带而非行星，太阳风和物质会在此处减速。

kb_4.en: The Kuiper Belt is sometimes mistakenly thought of as the boundary of the solar system, but the solar system also includes the Oort Cloud, which extends two light-years away. The Kuiper Belt is the source of short-period comets, such as Halley's Comet.
kb_4.cn: 柯伊伯带有时被误认为是太阳系的边界，但太阳系还包括向外延伸两光年之远的奥尔特星云。柯伊伯带是短周期彗星，如哈雷彗星，的来源地。

fs1_0.en: Sirius, also known as Alpha Canis Majoris, is the brightest star in the night sky, with an apparent magnitude of -1.46, almost twice as bright as Canopus, the second brightest star. What appears to the naked eye as a single star, Sirius is actually a binary star system, including a spectral type A1V blue dwarf star and a fainter spectral type DA2 white dwarf companion star, Sirius B. They revolve around each other at a distance of about 20 astronomical units (approximately the distance between the Sun and Uranus), with an orbital period of just over 50 years.
fs1_0.cn: 天狼星（大犬座α星）是夜空中最亮的恒星，其视星等为-1.46，几乎为第二亮恒星老人星的两倍。用肉眼看像一颗恒星的天狼星，实际上是一个双星系统，其中包括一颗光谱型A1V的蓝矮星和另一颗光谱型DA2的暗白矮星伴星天狼星B。它们互相围绕公转，相距约20天文单位（大概是太阳和天王星之间的距离），公转周期却只有50多年。

fs1_1.en: Sirius shines so brightly not only because of its high luminosity but also because it is very close to the Sun. Sirius is about 2.6 parsecs (about 8.6 light-years) away from Earth, making it one of the nearest stars to Earth. Sirius A has twice the mass of the Sun, with an absolute magnitude of 1.42, making it 25 times brighter than the Sun.
fs1_1.cn: 天狼星如此之亮，除了因为其原本就很高的光度以外，还因为距离太阳很近。天狼星距离地球约2.6秒差距（约8.6光年），是距离地球最近的恒星之一。天狼星A的质量为太阳的两倍，而绝对星等为1.42等，比太阳亮25倍。

fs1_2.en: In ancient Chinese astrology, Sirius was considered an evil star symbolizing "aggression". Qu Yuan in his "Nine Songs·Dong Jun" wrote, "Raise the long arrow and shoot the celestial wolf," likening Sirius to the Qin State located northwest of the Chu State. And in Su Shi's "River City Kid·Mi Zhou Out Hunting," "Will pull the eagle bow like a full moon, look northwest, shoot the celestial wolf," uses Sirius as a metaphor for the Western Xia threatening the northwest border of the Northern Song Dynasty.
fs1_2.cn: 中国古代星象学说中，天狼星是“主侵略之兆”的恶星。屈原在《九歌·东君》中写到：“举长矢兮射天狼”，以天狼星比拟位于楚国西北的秦国；而苏轼《江城子·密州出猎》中“会挽雕弓如满月，西北望，射天狼”，以天狼星比拟威胁北宋西北边境的西夏。

fs2_0.en: Canopus, also known as Alpha Carinae, the Polar Elder Star, or the Star of Longevity, is the brightest star in the southern constellation Carina. Canopus has an apparent magnitude of -0.72, making it the second brightest star in the sky, surpassed only by Sirius in the constellation Canis Major. It is located 310 light years away from the Solar System, which equates to an absolute magnitude of -5.71.
fs2_0.cn: 老人星（船底座α），也称为南极老人星、寿星，是南天船底座中最亮的恒星。老人星的视星等是-0.72等，是全天第二亮星，仅次于大犬座的天狼星。它距离太阳系310光年，换算其绝对星等为-5.71等。

fs2_1.en: Canopus is an unusual F-type bright white giant star. For most parts of the Southern Hemisphere, Canopus and Sirius can be observed concurrently at high positions. Their peak times in the night sky are only 21 minutes apart. When one is in regions located south of 38°latitude (for example, Melbourne in Australia, Wellington in New Zealand, Bahia Blanca in Argentina, and Valdivia in Chile), Canopus becomes a circumpolar star.
fs2_1.cn: 老人星是一颗不寻常的F型白色亮巨星，对于大部分的南半球地区，可以同时在高的位置观测到老人星及天狼星，它们在夜空中达到最高点的时间只相隔21分钟。当人们位在南纬38°以南的地区时（例如澳大利亚的墨尔本、新西兰的威灵顿、阿根廷的布兰卡港及智利的瓦尔迪维亚），老人星将成为一颗拱极星。

fs2_2.en: The English name of Canopus is generally believed to be derived from Greek mythology, referring to a ship captain of Menelaus, the king of Sparta during the Trojan War. In the Chinese perception, Canopus is a star that signifies peace and prosperity and is often grouped with "Lucky Star" and "Salary Star" to form the "Three Stars". In Japan, the image of Canopus, or "Jurojin" symbolizes one of the Seven Gods of Fortune, bringing good signs.
fs2_2.cn: 老人星的英文名称一般认为是出自希腊神话，是特洛伊战争时斯巴达国王墨涅拉俄斯的一位船长。老人星在中国人眼中是一颗象征国泰民安的吉星，常与“福星”、“禄星”并称“三星”。在日本，老人星的形象“寿老人”，是象征吉兆的七福神之一。

fs3_0.en: Rigil Kentaurus, also known as Alpha Centauri, is a triple star system located in the southern constellation Centaurus, comprised of two Sun-like stars, Alpha Centauri A (Rigil Kentaurus A), Alpha Centauri B (Rigil Kentaurus B), and a red dwarf star, Proxima Centauri (Alpha Centauri C). The former two form a binary system, indistinguishable from each other to the naked eye; the faint Proxima Centauri orbits the duo at a greater distance, invisible to the unaided eye.
fs3_0.cn: 南门二，即半人马座α，是位于南天的半人马座中的一个三合星系统，由两颗类太阳恒星南门二甲（半人马座α星A）、南门二乙（半人马座α星B）和一颗红矮星比邻星（半人马座α星C）组成。其中，前两者是一个双星系统，肉眼无法分辨彼此；暗弱的比邻星则在较远距离围绕两者公转，肉眼不可见。

fs3_1.en: In ancient China, Rigil Kentaurus along with Beta Centauri formed the stargate "Southern Gate". Legend has it that when Admiral Zheng He sailed to the Western Seas, he used it to guide his direction. In the West, Rigil Kentaurus was once the outer guide of the Southern Cross, as the location of the Southern Cross is too far south to be seen from most of the Northern Hemisphere.
fs3_1.cn: 在中国古代，南门二和南门一组成角宿中的星官“南门”。传闻当年郑和下西洋，就是用它来指引方向。在西方，南门二曾是南十字星座最外围的指引，因为南十字星座的位置太过南边，所以大部分的北半球都看不到。

fs3_2.en: The combined visual magnitude of Rigil Kentaurus is -0.27 with absolute magnitude 4.4, customarily considered the third brightest star in the night sky. Rigil Kentaurus is 4.37 light years (about 277,600 astronomical units) from the sun, making it the closest star system, with Proxima Centauri being only 4.24 light years away. Due to its relatively close distance to the solar system, in science fiction novels and video games, Rigil Kentaurus naturally becomes the "first port of call" for interstellar travel, with frequently recurring scenarios involving future colonization and development activities in this nearby neighbor due to Earth's population explosion.
fs3_2.cn: 南门二的综合视星等为-0.27等，绝对星等4.4等，习惯上视为夜空第三亮星。南门二距离太阳4.37光年（约277,600天文单位），是最近的恒星系，其中比邻星的距离只有4.24光年。因其与太阳系相对较近的距离，在科幻小说与电子游戏中，南门二理所当然的成为星际旅行的“第一个停靠港口”，未来地球人口爆炸时对这一近邻进行开发与殖民活动的情节也常有出现。

fs4_0.en: Arcturus (Boötes α) is the brightest star in the constellation Boötes. When viewed with the naked eye, Arcturus appears orange, with a visual magnitude of -0.04, making it the third brightest star in the night sky, surpassed only by Sirius and Canopus.
fs4_0.cn: 大角星（牧夫座α），是牧夫座中最明亮的恒星。以肉眼观看大角星，它是橘黄色的，视星等-0.04，是全夜空第3亮的恒星，仅次于天狼星与老人星。

fs4_1.en: Although Alpha Centauri (Rigil Kentaurus) has a visual magnitude of -0.27, it is a binary star comprising α1 with a magnitude of -0.01 and α2 with a magnitude of +1.33.
