Both individual stars are less bright than Arcturus, and because they are so close to each other, they can't be resolved by the naked eye. Therefore, while Rigil Kentaurus is a rather bright star, Alpha Centauri α1 is slightly dimmer than Arcturus and is the fourth brightest star in the sky. Both Arcturus and Rigil Kentaurus are located within our Local Interstellar Cloud.
fs4_1.cn: 虽然半人马座的南门二（半人马座α星）视星等是-0.27等，但它是由-0.01等的α1和+1.33等的α2组成的联星，个别的亮度都低于大角星，只因为它们太过接近，所以肉眼无法分辨出来。因此，南门二虽然是相当明亮的恒星，但半人马α1比大角星暗了一些，只是全天第4亮的恒星。大角星和南门二都位在本星际云中。

fs4_2.en: Although Arcturus is located in the Northern Hemisphere, its latitude is less than 20 degrees from the celestial equator, making it visible from both the northern and southern hemispheres. Observers in the Northern Hemisphere can find Arcturus by following the arc of the handle of the Big Dipper. Continuing along this arc also leads to Spica in the constellation Virgo. Arcturus, together with Spica and Regulus in the constellation Leo, form the Spring Triangle, and if you add Cor Caroli from the constellation Canes Venatici, it forms the Great Diamond of the spring.
fs4_2.cn: 大角星虽然位于北半球，但距离天球赤道的纬度少于20度，因此在南北两个半球都能看见。北半球的观察者可以沿着北斗星弧状的柄来找到大角星。顺着这个弧线继续延伸，也可以观测到角宿一。大角星与室女座角宿一、狮子座五帝座一共同组成春季大三角，如果再加上猎犬座的常陈一就成为春季大钻石。

fs5_0.en: Vega, also known as Lyra α or Vega Star, is the brightest star in the constellation Lyra, ranking fifth in the night sky. It is the second brightest star in the Northern Hemisphere, next only to Arcturus. Like Arcturus and Sirius, it's a star very close to Earth, only 25.3 light years away, and is one of the bright stars near the Sun. In ancient Chinese mythology of "The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl", the Weaver Girl is the granddaughter of the Heavenly Emperor, hence it is also called the Heavenly Granddaughter.
fs5_0.cn: 织女一又称为织女星或天琴座α，是天琴座最明亮的恒星，在夜空排名第五，是北半球第二明亮的恒星，仅次于大角星。与大角星及天狼星一样，是非常靠近地球的恒星，距地球只有25.3光年；也是太阳附近的明亮恒星。在中国古代的“牛郎织女”神话中，织女为天帝孙女，故亦称天孙。

fs5_1.en: Around 12,000 BC, Vega was the North Star for the northern hemisphere, but due to the precession of the equinoxes, it will again be the North Star in the year 13727, at which time its declination will reach +86°14'. Vega was the first star other than the Sun to be photographed by humans, and the first star to have a spectral record. It was also one of the early stars whose distance was estimated by parallax measurement.
fs5_1.cn: 织女星大约在公元前1万2千年曾是北半球的极星，但因岁差现象，它在13727年会再度成为北极星，届时它的赤纬会达到+86°14'。织女星是太阳之外第一颗由人类拍摄下来的恒星，也是第一颗有光谱纪录的恒星。它也是很早就由视差测量估计出距离的恒星。

fs5_2.en: In the summer of the Northern Hemisphere, observers can often see Vega near the zenith. As the benchmark for astronomy stellar magnitudes, its apparent magnitude is defined as 0, so astronomers use Vega as a standard for luminosity measurement. Vega is only a tenth the age of the Sun, but has 2.1 times the Sun's mass, and it is expected to have only a tenth the lifetime of the Sun.
fs5_2.cn: 在北半球的夏天，观测者多半可在天顶附近的位置见到织女星，因为身为天文学星等的标准，其视星等定义为0等，因此天文学家以织女星作为光度测定标准。织女星年龄只有太阳的十分之一，但质量是太阳的2.1倍，预期寿命也只有太阳的十分之一。

fs6_0.en: Capella (Auriga α), the brightest star in the constellation Auriga, is the sixth brightest star in the entire sky and the third brightest in the northern hemisphere, surpassed only by Arcturus and Vega. The Capella system is relatively close to Earth at a distance of only 42.2 light years (12.9 parsecs).
fs6_0.cn: 五车二 （御夫座α）是御夫座最亮的恒星，也是全天第六亮星，在北半球仅次于大角星和织女星，是北天第三亮星。五车二的系统相对邻近地球，距离只有42.2光年（12.9秒差距） 。

fs6_1.en: While it appears to be a single star to the naked eye, it is actually a star system, consisting of two binary pairs of stars. The two stars in the first pair are larger and brighter, both G-type giants. Each has a diameter 10 times that of the sun and is 2.5 times the mass of the sun, orbiting each other closely. These two stars are individually named Capella Aa and Capella Ab, and both will gradually cool and expand, evolving into red giants.
fs6_1.cn: 虽然以裸眼看它似乎只是一颗恒星，但它实际上是一个恒星系统，是由4颗恒星组成的两对联星。第一对的两颗暨大且亮，是G-型巨星，每颗的直径都是太阳的10倍，质量是太阳质量的2.5倍，在很靠近的轨道上互绕着。这两颗星各自的名称是五车二Aa和五车二Ab，未来也都会逐渐冷却和膨胀，演化成为红巨星。

fs6_2.en: The second pair of stars is located approximately 10,000 astronomical units away from the first pair, both of which are dim, low-mass, and relatively cooler red dwarf stars. They are named Capella H and Capella L, respectively.
fs6_2.cn: 第二对，与第一对相距大约10,000天文单位，且两颗都是黯淡、低质量、和相对较低温的红矮星，它们的名称分别是五车二H和五车二L。

fs7_0.en: Rigel, known as Orion Beta in Bayer nomenclature, is the brightest star in the constellation Orion and the seventh brightest star in the sky, with an apparent magnitude of 0.12.
fs7_0.cn: 参宿七，在拜耳命名法中称为猎户座β，是猎户座中最亮的恒星，并且是全天第7亮星，它的视星等为0.12等。

fs7_1.en: From the Earth's perspective, this is a triple star system, with the main star, Rigel A, being a supergiant with an absolute magnitude of -7.84, 130,000 times the brightness of the sun, and it's a Cepheid variable star with a fixed period.
fs7_1.cn: 从地球上观察，这是个三合星的系统，主星为参宿七A，是颗绝对星等 -7.84等的超巨星，亮度为太阳的130,000倍，是颗有固定周期的天鹅座α型变星。

fs7_2.en: Rigel B, which can be seen with a small telescope, is itself a spectroscopic binary, composed of two blue-white stars of spectral type B9. Although it is a Beta star in Bayer nomenclature, it is always brighter than Orion Alpha (Betelgeuse).
fs7_2.cn: 以小型望远镜就可以看见的参宿七B，本身就是光谱联星，由两颗光谱类型为B9的蓝白色恒星组成。虽然在拜耳命名法为β星，但它始终比猎户座α（参宿四）明亮。

fs8_0.en: The translation into English is: Procyon (also known as Canis Minoris α) is a star with a visual magnitude of 0.34, ranking the 8th brightest star in the list of stellar brightness, and is also the brightest star in this constellation.
fs8_0.cn: 南河三（亦作小犬座α）是一颗视星等为0.34的恒星，为恒星亮度列表中第8亮的恒星，同时也是该星座最亮的恒星。

fs8_1.en: However, according to modern observation methods, Procyon is actually a binary star system composed of two stars. The main star is Procyon A, a white F5 IV-V main sequence star, and the companion star is Procyon B, a DQZ-type white dwarf star. This binary star system is approximately 11.46 light-years away from the solar system (3.51 parsecs), making it a nearby star.
fs8_1.cn: 但据现代观测手段，南河三实为两颗恒星组成的联星系统，其主星为南河三A，一颗白色F5 IV–V型主序星，伴星为南河三B，一颗DQZ型白矮星。该联星系统距太阳系约11.46光年（3.51秒差距），因此其亦属于邻近恒星。

fs8_2.en: The best time to observe Procyon is in winter, and it forms the famous Winter Triangle together with Sirius of the Canis Major constellation and Betelgeuse of the Orion constellation.
fs8_2.cn: 南河三的最佳观测时间为冬季，其与大犬座的天狼星和猎户座的参宿四共同组成了著名的冬季大三角。

fs9_0.en: As the brightest star in the constellation of Puppis (located at the southern end of Puppis), Puppis α, also known as Achernar, is the ninth brightest star in the entire sky, approximately 139 light-years from Earth. Among the nine brightest stars in the entire sky, Achernar is the hottest and the bluest.
fs9_0.cn: 水委一既波江座α星，是波江座最明亮的恒星（位于波江座的南端），也是全天空第九亮的恒星，距离地球约139光年。在全天空最明亮的九颗恒星中水委一是最炙热，颜色也是最蓝的一颗。

fs9_1.en: It's approximately 6 to 8 times the mass of the sun, and astronomers classify it as a main sequence star. The stellar spectrum belongs to type B6, with a brightness 3150 times that of the sun and an absolute magnitude of -2.78. Achernar is located to the south, so for many of the densely populated areas in the Northern Hemisphere, Achernar always stays below the horizon and can't be observed north of 33 degrees latitude.
fs9_1.cn: 它质量约为6到8倍太阳质量，被天文学家分类为主序星，恒星光谱属于B6型，亮度为太阳的3150倍，绝对星等为-2.78等。水委一的位置偏南，所以对于北半球许多人口稠密的地区而言，水委一永远位于地平线之下（北纬33度以北的地区无法观测）。

fs9_2.en: Achernar is oblate due to its high-speed self-rotation. Until March 2000, Achernar and Polaris were the most distant first-magnitude stars on the celestial sphere. Antares in Scorpius is the loneliest first-magnitude star, but there are many bright second-magnitude stars nearby, whereas the night sky around Polaris and Achernar is relatively dim by comparison.
fs9_2.cn: 水委一在高速自转下呈现扁球体，直到2000年3月为止，北落师门与水委一是天球中角距离最远的两颗一等星。而天蝎座的心宿二则是最孤独的一等星，但是心宿二附近有许多明亮的二等星，相较之下北落师门与水委一附近的夜空则较为黯淡。

fs10_0.en: Betelgeuse is a spectral type M1-2 red supergiant and one of the largest stars visible to the naked eye. It is typically the 10th brightest star in the night sky and the second brightest in the constellation Orion, just after Rigel.
fs10_0.cn: 参宿四是一颗光谱类型M1-2的红超巨星，也是肉眼可见的最大恒星之一。它通常是夜空中第10亮的恒星，也是猎户座的第二亮星，仅次于参宿七。

fs10_1.en: It is a significant red semi-regular variable star, whose visual magnitude varies between +0.0 and +1.6, making it the star with the widest range of brightness among first-class stars. Under near-infrared wavelengths, Betelgeuse is the brightest star in the night sky.
fs10_1.cn: 它是一颗明显的红色半规则变星，其视星等在+0.0和+1.6之间变化，是一等星中变光范围最宽的。在近红外波长下，参宿四是夜空中最亮的恒星。

fs10_2.en: If Betelgeuse were at the center of our solar system, its surface would lie beyond the asteroid belt, swallowing everything within the orbits of Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. Because of various reasons, its distance has always been difficult to measure, with current best estimates around 500-600 light years.
fs10_2.cn: 如果参宿四位于我们太阳系的中心，它的表面将位于小行星带之外，水星、金星、地球和火星轨道以内的一切都将被它吞噬。由于各种原因，它的距离一直很难测量，目前的最佳估计值约为500－600光年。

fs11_0.en: Hadar, also known as Beta Centauri, is a star with a visual magnitude of 0.61, located in the constellation Centaurus. It is the 11th brightest star on the list of stellar brightness, and the second brightest star in this constellation, the first one being Rigil Kentaurus.
fs11_0.cn: 马腹一（半人马座β）是一颗视星等为0.61的恒星，位于半人马座。其为恒星亮度列表中第11亮的恒星，亦是该星座第二亮的恒星（第一为南门二）。

fs11_1.en: According to modern observation methods, Hadar is actually a star system composed of multiple stars, consisting of three stars; Centauri β Aa, Ab, and B. According to the parallax measured by the Gaia satellite, this system is approximately 390 light years (120 parsecs) from the solar system.
fs11_1.cn: 据现代观测手段，马腹一实为由多颗恒星组成的恒星系统，由三颗恒星组成，分别为半人马座β Aa、Ab和B。据依巴谷卫星所测量的视差计算，该系统距太阳系约为390光年（120秒差距）。

fs11_2.en: People often use Hadar to locate the Southern Cross, which helps in defining directions. The line formed by Hadar and Rigil Kentaurus points to the top of the Southern Cross, known as the Crucis α, and the line formed by Crucis α and the bottom end of the Southern Cross, Crucis β, points to the southern celestial pole.
fs11_2.cn: 人们常用马腹一来寻找南十字座，进而确定方位。其与南门二所组成的连线指向南十字座的顶端——十字架一，而十字架一与十字架的底端——十字架二所组成的连线则指向南天极。

fs12_0.en: Altair, also famously known as "Niu Lang star" or Alpha Aquilae is also called "Qian Niu star" or "Grand General", and in Japanese it is known as "Hikoboshi". Altair is ranked as the twelfth brightest star in the whole sky and appears white. In sky observation, it is one of the vertices of the Summer Triangle. A line drawn from Altair, through Beta Aquilae (Alshain) and Gamma Aquilae (Tarazed), points to the star Vega.
fs12_0.cn: 河鼓二，即著名的“牛郎星”，“天鹰座α”，又叫“牵牛星”或“大将军”，在日文中称作“彦星”。河鼓二排名全天第十二的明亮恒星，白色。在星空观测中，是夏季大三角中的一角。它和天鹰座β星（河鼓一）、天鹰座γ星（河鼓三）的连线正指向织女星。

fs12_1.en: Altair is 16.7 light years away from the solar system and is a main-sequence star in the A-type of stellar spectra. It has 1.7 times the mass of the Sun, 1.8 times the diameter, and is 10.6 times as bright. Its surface temperature is about 7000 degrees Celsius.
fs12_1.cn: 河鼓二距离太阳系16.7光年，是恒星光谱A型中的主序星。它的质量是太阳的1.7倍，直径为太阳的1.8倍，亮度是太阳的10.6倍。表面温度约7000摄氏度。

fs12_2.en: Altair shares many similarities with the famous star Sirius: both are very young stars (possibly only a few hundred million years old), and their cores are composed of helium produced by the nuclear fusion reaction of hydrogen. Stars of this kind, around the age of 3.5 billion years, contract inward due to the exhaustion of hydrogen supplies, form red giants, and eventually evolve into white dwarfs.
fs12_2.cn: 该星与著名的天狼星存在很多相似之处：都是非常年轻的恒星（形成时间可能仅有数亿年），其内核都是由氢的核聚变反应产生的氦构成。这样的恒星，在其寿命达到35亿年左右时，由于氢原料的耗尽而向内收缩，形成红巨星，最终演化成白矮星。

fs13_0.en: Acrux, also known as Alpha Crucis, is the brightest star in the constellation Crux and ranks as the 13th brightest star in the night sky, with an apparent magnitude of 0.77. It is a triple star system, 320 light years away from the Solar System, but only two stars can be distinguished by naked eye observation. The distance between α1 and α2 is only 4 arcseconds.
fs13_0.cn: 十字架二（南十字座α）是南十字座内最亮的恒星，也是夜空中第13亮的恒星，视星等0.77。它是一个距离太阳系320光年远的三合星系统，但以目视观测只能分辨出两颗星。α1和α2之间相距只有4弧秒。

fs13_1.en: Acrux is one of the five stars in the Southern Cross depicted on the flags of Australia and New Zealand, and also appears in the Southern Cross on the Brazilian flag. Each of the 26 stars on the flag represents a state, with Acrux representing the state of São Paulo.
fs13_1.cn: 十字架二是出现在澳洲和新西兰国旗上的南十字座五颗星中之一，他也出现在巴西国旗上的南十字座内，与旗帜上的26颗星各自分别代表一个州，它代表的是圣保罗州。

fs13_2.en: Acrux is located at about 60°south latitude, and one needs to be south of the Tropic of Cancer to see it. Nevertheless, due to the wobble of the Earth, ancient Indian astronomers named it Tri-shanku. In ancient Indian Sanskrit, the constellation Crux was even represented by a swastika, a symbol of auspiciousness.
fs13_2.cn: 十字架二的位置大约在南纬60°，要在北回归线以南的地区才能看见。尽管如此，由于地球的晃动，古印度的天文学家称他为三炫谷（Tri-shanku），古老的印度梵文也以代表吉祥的万字符号代表南十字座。

fs14_0.en: Aldebaran, located in the zodiac constellation Taurus, is a red giant star approximately 65 light-years away from the Sun. It is the brightest star in Taurus, and although its apparent magnitude slowly varies between 0.75 and 0.95, it remains the 14th brightest star in the entire sky.
fs14_0.cn: 毕宿五位在黄道星座的金牛座中，是颗距离太阳大约65光年的红巨星。它是金牛座中最亮的恒星，尽管它的视星等在0.75和0.95等之间缓慢变化著，仍是全天第14亮星。

fs14_1.en: This red giant star Aldebaran is larger than the Sun, with a surface temperature lower than the Sun's at only 3,900K. However, its radius is 44 times that of the Sun, so its luminosity exceeds the Sun's by over 400 times. It has a slow rotation, taking 520 days to complete a full revolution.
fs14_1.cn: 毕宿五这颗红巨星比太阳更大，表面温度比太阳低，只有3,900K，但是半径是太阳的44倍，因此亮度超过太阳400余倍。它的自转缓慢，需要520天才能完成一周。

fs14_2.en: Aldebaran has a planet, Aldebaran b, which is several times the size of Jupiter. Pioneer 10, a space probe in search of planets, is currently heading in the direction of this star and its planet. It is estimated that it will be closest to them in about 2 million years.
fs14_2.cn: 毕宿五拥有一颗大小约是木星数倍的行星，称为毕宿五b。探测行星的先锋10号目前正朝着这颗恒星以及其行星的方向前进，估计在200万年后会最接近它们。

fs15_0.en: Antares, also known as Alpha Scorpii, is the nearest red supergiant to the Solar System and the 15th brightest star in the night sky. Along with Aldebaran, Regulus, and Capella, it is one of the four brightest stars near the ecliptic, and also the brightest star in the constellation Scorpius, representing the "heart of the scorpion."
fs15_0.cn: 心宿二（天蝎座α），是距离太阳系最近的红超巨星，也是夜空中第15亮的星。它与毕宿五、角宿一、和轩辕十四是靠近黄道最亮的四颗恒星，也是天蝎座内最亮的恒星，代表着"蝎子的心脏"。

fs15_1.en: It is a distinctly but slowly variable star with an average magnitude of +1.02 and forms a visual binary star system with a blue main sequence star. Antares also serves as a radio source and is the brightest, most massive, and most evolved star among the nearest OB star associations. It is part of the Scorpius subgroup in the Scorpius-Centaurus association, which includes thousands of stars with an average age of 1.1 million years and lies about 170 parsecs (550 light-years) away.
fs15_1.cn: 它是一个光变明显但缓慢的半规则变星，平均星等是+1.02。并与一个蓝色主序星组成一个目视双星系统。心宿二还是射电源，是最靠近我们的OB星协的成员中最亮、质量最大、和已演化的恒星，属于天蝎-半人马星协上天蝎次集团的成员，其中包括成千上万颗平均年龄110万年的恒星，距离约为170秒差距（550光年）。

fs15_2.en: In China, it is the second star in the Xin constellation among the seven constellations of the Azure Dragon of the East, hence the name Xin 2 (Antares), also known as Fire Star. Historically, it was used to determine seasons. The saying "fire moves in July" refers to the westward movement of the Fire Star, signifying the onset of cooler weather.
fs15_2.cn: 在中国，它是东方苍龙七宿中心宿的第二颗星，所以称为心宿二，又称为大火。过去用来确定季节。“七月流火”即是大火星西行，天气将寒之意。

fs16_0.en: Spica (Virgo α) is the sixteenth brightest star in the entire sky and the brightest star in the Virgo constellation. Observers in the Northern Hemisphere can see this bright first-magnitude star in the southeastern sky on spring nights. It can be found by following the curve formed by the handle of the Big Dipper in Ursa Major and the tip of Bootes.
fs16_0.cn: 角宿一（室女座α），是全天空第十六亮的恒星，也是室女座最明亮的恒星。北半球的观测者在春季夜晚，可以在东南方向的天空看到这颗明亮的1等星,只需要沿着位于大熊座的北斗七星的斗柄和牧夫座的大角连成的曲线方向往下就可以看到它。

fs16_1.en: Spica is 260 light-years away from Earth and is a binary star system: Spica A is a blue giant star and is a type of Cepheid variable star. Spica B is smaller than Spica A and is a main sequence star, with the two stars only 0.12 astronomical units apart.
fs16_1.cn: 角宿一距离地球有260光年之遥，它是一个双星系统：角宿一A是一颗蓝巨星，属于仙王座β型变星。角宿一B比角宿一A小，是一颗主序星，颗恒星彼此距离只有0.12天文单位。

fs16_2.en: In autumn, the sun passes through Virgo, making Spica a symbolic star of autumn harvest. Its English name, Spica, comes from Latin, meaning "ear of wheat of the virgin". In Chinese astronomy, Spica is located in the constellation Jiao. In Indian astronomy, it corresponds to Chitra in the twenty-seven lunar mansions. In medieval astronomy, Spica was classified as a fixed star of the Gypsies, symbolizing emerald and sage.
fs16_2.cn: 秋季时太阳会经过室女座，这使得角宿一成为秋季作物收获的象征星，英文名称Spica来自于拉丁语，意为“室女的麦穗”。角宿一在中国天文学中位于角宿。角宿一在印度天文学中，对应于二十七宿中的Chitra。在中世纪天文学中，角宿一被分类为吉普赛固定之星，象征祖母绿及鼠尾草。

fs17_0.en: Pollux, also known as Gemini β, is about 34 light-years away from the sun. It is an evolved giant star with an orange hue and is the closest giant star to the sun. The distance from it to the sun, as measured by parallax by the Gaia astrometry satellite, is approximately 33.78 light-years (10.36 parsecs).
fs17_0.cn: 北河三，即双子座β星，距离太阳约34光年，已经演化呈现橙色色调的巨星，它是最接近太阳的巨星。依巴谷天文测量卫星以视差测得它与太阳的距离大约是33.78光年（10.36秒差距）。

fs17_1.en: Since 1943, the spectrum of this star has been one of the standards for other classifications. In 2006, a planet was discovered orbiting it, named Pollux b (β Gem b), and its orbit has been confirmed.
fs17_1.cn: 北河三的视星等为1.14等，在亮星表中，它比同星座的北河二（双子座α）还要明亮。北河三和太阳相比，质量约为太阳的2倍，直径约为太阳的9倍。北河三原本是一颗A型主序星，但已经耗尽了核心的氢燃料，并演化成为光谱类型为K0III的巨星。

fs17_2.en: Pollux has an apparent magnitude of 1.14, making it brighter on the list of bright stars than Castor (Gemini α) in the same constellation. Compared to the Sun, Pollux has about twice the mass and is approximately 9 times the diameter. Pollux was originally an A-type main sequence star, but it has exhausted its core hydrogen fuel and evolved into a giant star with a spectral type of K0III.
fs17_2.cn: 自1943年迄今，这颗恒星的光谱是其它分类的依据标准之一。在2006年，发现它有一颗行星，被命名为北河三b（β Gem b），并已确认它的轨道。

fs18_0.en: Fomalhaut, also known as Piscis Austrinus α, is the brightest star in the Piscis Austrinus constellation and one of the brightest stars in the night sky. According to observations from the Gaia satellite, Fomalhaut is an A-type main sequence star, approximately 25 light-years (7.7 parsecs) away from the Sun. Fomalhaut is a young star, thought to be between 100 million and 300 million years old, with a potential lifespan of 1 billion years.
fs18_0.cn: 北落师门，也称为南鱼座α，是南鱼座中最明亮的恒星，也是夜空中最明亮的恒星之一。根据依巴谷卫星的观测结果，北落师门属于A型主序星，距离太阳约25光年（7.7秒差距） 。北落师门是一颗年轻的恒星，多年来认为他的年龄在1至3亿岁之间，潜在的寿命是10亿年。

fs18_1.en: Fomalhaut, like Vega, emits an excess of infrared radiation, indicating that it is surrounded by a circumstellar disk. Fomalhaut, the K-type main sequence star TW Piscis Austrini (Fomalhaut B), and the M-type red dwarf LP 876-10 (Fomalhaut C) together form a triple star system, with the companion stars approximately 8 degrees apart.
fs18_1.cn: 北落师门和织女星类似，会发出过量的红外线辐射，表明该星被星周盘环绕着。北落师门、K型主序星南鱼座TW（北落师门 B）和M型红矮星LP 876-10（北落师门 C）共同组成三合星系统，伴星彼此之间相距约8度。

fs18_2.en: it is the first star system where a possible exoplanet (named Fomalhaut b, later called "Dagon") was imaged in visible light. Analysis of existing and new data suggests that Dagon is not a planet, but a dust disk caused by a collision. This dust disk is divided into several layers, with the inner layer 0.1 astronomical units from the star, composed of small particles rich in carbon.Fomalhaut is the third brightest known star with a planetary system (as observed from Earth), second only to the Sun and Pollux.
fs18_2.cn: 北落师门是第一个以可见光谱成像得出可能有系外行星（称为北落师门 b，后称“大衮”）的恒星系统。现有数据和新数据的分析表明大衮其实不是行星，而是由一次碰撞导致的尘埃盘。该尘埃盘分为数层，内层离恒星0.1天文单位，由高碳小颗粒构成。北落师门是已知具有行星系统的第三亮星（从地球观测），仅次于太阳和北河三。

fs19_0.en: Deneb, also known as Cygnus α, is a first-magnitude star in the constellation Cygnus. It is the brightest star in Cygnus and the 19th brightest star in the night sky. It is also one of the endpoints of both the Summer Triangle and the Northern Cross. Deneb is a blue-white supergiant with an average apparent magnitude of 1.25.
fs19_0.cn: 天津四是在天鹅座中的一颗一等星，它是天鹅座中最亮的恒星．也是是夜空的第19亮星。它也是夏季大三角和北十字这两个星群的端点之一。天津四是颗蓝白色的超巨星，平均视星等1.25等。

fs19_1.en: However, due to its great distance, it is little known that its brightness is 55,000 to 196,000 times that of the sun. Due to the precession of the Earth, Deneb will be a pole-like star (7°from the North Pole) around the year 9800 AD.
fs19_1.cn: 然而，因为距离遥远，它的亮度是太阳亮度的55,000至196,000倍却鲜为人知。由于地球的岁差，大约在公元9800年天津四将是一颗类似极星（离北极点7°）。

fs19_2.en: Deneb's initial mass is about 23 times that of the sun. For most of its early life, it was an O-type main sequence star, but now it has exhausted its core hydrogen and has begun to cool and expand. Given Deneb's mass range, it will eventually expand into the brightest red supergiant, and its core will collapse and explode as a supernova within a few million years.
fs19_2.cn: 天津四的初始质量大约是太阳的23倍，在生命早期的大部分时间是颗O型主序星，但现在它已经耗尽核心的氢，并开始冷却和膨胀。以天津四的质量范围，它最终将膨胀成为最明亮的红超巨星，并且在数百万年内核心就会坍缩，发生超新星爆炸。

fs20_0.en: Mimosa (Crux β), is the second brightest star in the constellation Crux, only surpassed by Acrux (Crux α), and is the 20th brightest star in the night sky.
fs20_0.cn: 十字架三（南十字座β），是南十字座第二亮星，仅次于十字架二（南十字α），也是夜空第20亮星。

fs20_1.en: Mimosa is a blue giant star, located about 280 light-years away from Earth, and is a binary star composed of two stars, α and β. The primary star is a Beta Cephei variable star, with a magnitude variation of approximately 0.08 and a period of about 0.19 days; the companion star is about 2.9 magnitudes fainter than the primary.
fs20_1.cn: 十字架三是一颗蓝色巨星，距离地球约有280光年，并由甲、乙两颗星组成的双星。主星是仙王座β型变星，变幅大约为0.08个目视星等，周期大约为0.19天；伴星比主星暗约2.9等。

fs20_2.en: Mimosa is also a member of the famous star cluster known as the Southern Cross, but it is located in the sky at a declination of -60 degrees, so it can only be seen from locations south of the Tropic of Cancer. It is also an X-ray source and a member of the Scorpius-Centaurus Association.
fs20_2.cn: 十字架三也是著名星群，称为南十字星的成员之一，但位于赤纬-60度的天空，所以只有在北回归线以南的地方才可以看到它。它也是一个X射线源，是天蝎半人马星协的成员之一。

fs21_0.en: Regulus (Leo α), also known as Cor Leonis, is the brightest star in the constellation Leo (the main star) and the 21st brightest star in the entire sky. Regulus is a white main sequence star, approximately 77.5 light-years away from Earth, making it the closest B-type main sequence star to Earth.
fs21_0.cn: 轩辕十四（狮子座α）是狮子座最明亮的恒星（主星），也是全天空第21亮的恒星。轩辕十四是一颗白色主序星，距离地球约77.5光年，是距离地球最近的B型主序星。

fs21_1.en: From Earth, it is located in the "heart" position of the constellation Leo. Regulus is considered the dimmest of the first-magnitude stars, as the star following it, Arcus Septima, has an apparent magnitude of +1.5 and is considered a second-magnitude star by the astronomical community.
fs21_1.cn: 在地球上看它位于狮子座的“心脏”位置。轩辕十四被认为是最黯淡的1等星，因为排在它之后的弧矢七的视星等为+1.5等，被天文学界视为是一颗2等星。

fs21_2.en: Xuanyuan is the name of the ancient Chinese emperor Huangdi, who is considered the ancestor of the Chinese nation. The constellation Xuanyuan consists of seventeen stars, shaped like a yellow dragon winding across the sky, with its brightest star, Xuanyuan Fourteen, often referred to as the empress due to its proximity to the Five Emperors constellation. Regulus means "prince" or "little king" in Latin, and the Greek variant Basiliscus and Qalb Al Asad are also used to refer to Regulus.
fs21_2.cn: 轩辕是中国古代帝王黄帝的名字，他被认为是中华民族的始祖。轩辕共十七星，形状如黄龙蜿蜒于天际之上，其最亮星十四星因在五帝座旁，多借指皇后。Regulus在拉丁语中是“王子”或“小国王”的意思，而希腊语的变体Basiliscus及Qalb Al Asad也被使用来称呼轩辕十四。

fs22_0.en: Adhara (Canis Major ε) is a binary star. It is the second brightest star in the constellation Canis Major, with an apparent magnitude of +1.50, and is one of the bright stars listed in the Bright Star Catalogue. About 4.7 million years ago, its apparent magnitude was as high as -3.99, making it the brightest star in the sky at that time. Based on the parallax measured by the Hipparcos satellite, its distance from the sun is approximately 430 light-years.
fs22_0.cn: 弧矢七（大犬座ε）是一对联星。它是大犬座的第二亮星，视星等+1.50，也是亮星表中的一颗亮星。大约在470万年前，它的视星等高达-3.99，是当时天空中最亮的恒星。依据依巴谷卫星测量的视差推算，它与太阳的距离大约是430光年。

fs22_1.en: Adhara is a binary star, with the primary star Adhara A having an apparent magnitude of +1.5 and a spectral type of B2. Due to its surface temperature of 22,200K, its color is blue or blue-white.
fs22_1.cn: 弧矢七是联星，主星弧矢七A的视星等是+1.5等，光谱类型为B2。由于表面的温度是22,200K，因此，它的颜色是蓝色或蓝白色。

fs22_2.en: The traditional English name of Adhara comes from Arabic, meaning "virgin". In Chinese astronomy, "Hu Shi" means bow and arrow. It forms an asterism "Hu Shi" with Delta Canis Majoris (Hu Shi Er), Eta Canis Majoris (Hu Shi Yi), C Puppis, ZI674, Omicron Puppis, Kappa Puppis, k Canis Majoris, and Pi Puppis, representing a bow and arrow aimed at Sirius.
fs22_2.cn: 弧矢七传统的英文名称源自阿拉伯文，意思是“处女”。在中国天文学中，弧矢意思是弓和箭。它与弧矢二（大犬座δ星）、弧矢一（大犬座η星）、船尾座C星、ZI674、船尾座ο星、船尾座κ星、大犬座k星和船尾座π星组成一个星官“弧矢”，是瞄准天狼星的弓与箭。

fs23_0.en: Castor (Gemini α), also known as Alpha Geminorum, is a star located in the constellation Gemini. It is a famous multiple star system, composed of six stars in total.
fs23_0.cn: 北河二（双子座α）是一颗位于双子座的恒星，是一颗著名的聚星，共为六颗星所组成。

fs23_1.en: Both Castor and Pollux (Gemini β) are among the bright stars in the winter night sky. These two bright stars are considered a pair in many ethnic myths. In Bayer's naming system, Castor was named α because it appears in the night sky earlier than Pollux, but in terms of apparent magnitude, the later-rising β star (Pollux) is brighter.
fs23_1.cn: 北河二在1678年被发现是一颗双星，两颗成员的视星等分别为2.8和2.0，二者的距离约为6″，绕行周期约为467年。北河二还有一个距离72″的暗伴星，我们少数已知的成员都是M型矮星的食双星系统。北河三的每个成员自身都是分光双星，这样的话，北河二实际上是一个六星系统。

fs23_2.en: Castor was discovered to be a binary star in 1678, with the two members having apparent magnitudes of 2.8 and 2.0 respectively, and a distance of about 6″, with an orbital period of about 467 years. Castor also has a faint companion star at a distance of 72″, and we know that some of the members are M dwarf eclipsing binary systems. Each member of Castor itself is a spectroscopic binary, so in fact, Castor is a six-star system.
fs23_2.cn: 北河二与北河三（双子座β）都是冬季夜空中的亮星之一。这两个亮星在许多民族的神话中都视为一对。在拜耳命名法中，北河二因为比北河三早出现在夜空中而被命名为α星，但在视星等上，稍晚些才升起的β星（北河三）比它光亮。

fs24_0.en: Shaula (Scorpius λ), also known as Lambda Scorpii, is the second brightest star in the constellation Scorpius and one of the brightest stars in the night sky. Although Shaula is the second brightest star in Scorpius, it is named λ in Bayer's naming system. Its common English name comes from Arabic, meaning "raised tail", because it forms the tail of the scorpion (Scorpius).
fs24_0.cn: 尾宿八(天蝎座λ) 是天蝎座的第二亮星，也是夜空中最亮的星之一。虽然尾宿八是天蝎座第二亮星，但其在拜耳命名法中被命名为λ。其英文俗名来自阿拉伯语，意为“翘起的尾巴”，因为其形成了蝎子（天蝎座）的尾巴。

fs24_1.en: Ranked 25th on the list of bright stars, its apparent magnitude is 1.6 and its absolute magnitude is -4.60. It is 570 light-years away from Earth. Its spectral luminosity type is B1.5IV, and its luminosity in the visible light band is 5900 times that of the Sun.
fs24_1.cn: 在亮星表上排名第24，视星等为1.6等，绝对星等-4.60等。距离地球570光年。光谱光度型为B1.5IV，可见光波段光度为太阳的5900倍。

fs24_2.en: Shaula is also a multiple star system. A telescope can resolve it into a bright star of magnitude 1.6 and two faint stars below magnitude 12. The 1.6 magnitude primary star also contains three closely spaced stars, so the total number of stars in this system reaches five.
fs24_2.cn: 尾宿八也是一颗聚星，用望远镜可以将其分辨为一个1.6等的亮星以及2颗12等以下的暗弱恒星。而1.6等的主星中也包含了相距很近的3颗恒星，所以这个系统的总恒星数目便达到了5颗。

fs25_0.en: Gacrux (Crux γ), also known as Gamma Crucis, is the nearest red giant star to the Sun. As Gacrux is located in the sky at a declination of -60 degrees, it can only be seen from places south of the Tropic of Cancer.
fs25_0.cn: 十字架一（南十字座γ），是距离太阳最近的红巨星。由于十字架一位于赤纬-60度的天空，所以只有在北回归线以南的地方才可以看到它。

fs25_1.en: According to parallax measurements by the Hipparcos satellite, Gacrux is about 88 light-years away from the Sun. With an apparent magnitude of 1.64, it is the third brightest star in the southern circumpolar constellation Crux, and one of the brightest stars in the entire sky. It is a semi-regular variable star, with multiple periods.
fs25_1.cn: 根据依巴谷卫星的视差测量，十字架一距离太阳大约88光年。视星等1.64，是南天拱极星座南十字座内第三亮的恒星，并且是全天最亮星之一。它是一个半规则变星，有多重的周期。

fs25_2.en: It has evolved away from the main sequence and become a red giant star, but it is likely now on the red giant branch rather than the asymptotic giant branch. Although it is only 30% more massive than the Sun, at this stage it has expanded to 90 times the radius of the Sun. It radiates about 1,000 times the luminosity of the Sun, with an outer atmosphere temperature of about 3,400K, giving it a distinct orange-red color.
fs25_2.cn: 它已经演化离主序带，变成一颗红巨星，但是现在很可能是在红巨星分支而不是渐近巨星分支。虽然质量只比太阳大30%，在这个阶段它已经膨胀到90倍太阳半径。辐射出大约1000倍太阳光度，外层大气温度约3,400K，它的颜色是显著的橙红色。

fs26_0.en: Bellatrix (Orion γ), also known as Gamma Orionis, is a star in the constellation Orion, located 5°west of Betelgeuse (Orion α).
fs26_0.cn: 参宿五（猎户座γ），亦作猎户座γ，是猎户座中的一颗恒星，位于参宿四（猎户座α）以西5°的位置。

fs26_1.en: Bellatrix has a mass 8.6 times that of the Sun and is approximately 25 million years old. It was previously classified as a giant star, but is now classified as a B-type main-sequence star. Its distance from the solar system is about 250 light-years (77 parsecs), from which its radius is calculated to be about 6 times that of the Sun.
fs26_1.cn: 参宿五的质量是太阳质量的8.6倍，其年龄约为2500万年，以前分类巨星、现在分类B型主序星。其距太阳系的距离约为250光年（77秒差距），因此而推算出其半径约为太阳半径的6倍。

fs26_2.en: Bellatrix was once thought to belong to the Orion OB1 association, moving together with other stars in the association in a larger space. This association also includes the famous Orion's Belt (i.e., Alnitak, Alnilam, and Mintaka). However, later research showed that Bellatrix is much closer to the solar system than other stars in the association, so this view was refuted.
fs26_2.cn: 参宿五曾被认为属于猎户座OB1星协，它与星协中的其他恒星在一个较大的空间中共同运动，该星协还包括著名的猎户座腰带（即参宿一、参宿二以及参宿三），但后来的研究显示，参宿五较之星协中其他恒星远靠近于太阳系，因此该看法被否定。

fs27_0.en: Elnath (Taurus β), also known as Beta Tauri, is the second brightest star in the constellation Taurus, with an apparent magnitude of 1.65. It is 134 light-years away from Earth and is a chemically peculiar B7 giant star.
fs27_0.cn: 五车五（金牛座β），为金牛座第二亮星，视星等为1,65等。它距离地球134光年，是一颗化学性质特殊的B7巨星

fs27_1.en: This star, being on the border of Taurus and Auriga, had two cname in the Bayer designation: Taurus β and Auriga γ. Ptolemy considered this star to be shared by Auriga and Taurus, so Johann Bayer assigned it a name in both constellations.
fs27_1.cn: 这颗恒星因为位于金牛座与御夫座的边界，所以在拜耳命名法中曾有两个名称：金牛座β和御夫座γ。托勒密认为这颗恒星由御夫座和金牛座共用，所以约翰·拜耳在两个星座中都为它指定了一个名称。

fs27_2.en: In China, "Wuche" means "five chariots", referring to the asterism composed of Taurus β, Auriga ι, Auriga α, Auriga β, and Auriga θ. Therefore, the Chinese name for Taurus β is Wuche Wu (Five Chariots Five).
fs27_2.cn: 在中国，五车的意思为“五辆战车”，指由金牛座β、御夫座ι、御夫座α、御夫座β和御夫座θ组成的星官。因此，金牛座β的中国名称是五车五。

fs28_0.en: Miaplacidus (Carina β), also known as Beta Carinae, is the second brightest star in the constellation Carina and one of the brightest stars in the entire sky, with an apparent magnitude of +1.68.
fs28_0.cn: 翻译成英文：南船五（船底座β）是船底座第二亮星，也是全天最亮的恒星之一，视星等为+1.68。

fs28_1.en: It is the brightest star in the well-known southern constellation Diamond Cross, located at the southwest end of this star cluster. The English name Miaplacidus means "calm waters". It is located near the planetary nebula IC 2448.
fs28_1.cn: 它是广为人知的南极星群钻石十字中最亮的恒星，位于该星群的西南端。南船五英文名意为“平静的水”。它位于行星状星云IC 2448附近。

fs29_0.en: Alnilam (Orion ε), located in the constellation Orion, is also known as Orion 46 in the Flamsteed designation system. It is the 29th brightest star in the entire night sky and ranks 4th in the constellation Orion.
fs29_0.cn: 参宿二（猎户座ε）位于猎户座，在佛兰斯蒂德命名法中称为猎户座46。它是全夜空第29亮的恒星，在猎户座中则名列第4位。

fs29_1.en: Alnilam is a B0Ia blue supergiant star. When observed from Earth, it is found on the belt of Orion. People living in mid-latitude regions will find Alnilam at its highest point in the sky at midnight on December 15 each year.
fs29_1.cn: 参宿二是一颗B0Ia蓝超巨星，从地球上观测参宿二，会发现它位在猎户座的腰带上。居住在中纬度地区的人们会在每年12月15日的半夜发现参宿二位在天空中的最高点。

fs29_2.en: Because the spectrum of Alnilam is relatively simple, it is very useful for astronomers studying interstellar matter. In the next million years, this star may evolve into a Wolf-Rayet star and explode into a supernova.
fs29_2.cn: 因为参宿二光谱相对简单，对于天文学家研究星际物质非常有用。在接下来的百万年内，这颗星可能演化成为沃尔夫–拉叶星，并爆炸成为超新星。

fs30_0.en: Alnair (Grus α), also known as Gruis α, is the brightest star in the constellation Grus, ranking 30th in brightness in the entire sky.
fs30_0.cn: 鹤一（天鹤座α）是天鹤座最亮的恒星，全天亮度排名30。

fs30_1.en: The English name of Alnair comes from Arabic, derived from its Arabic name al-Nayyir min Dhanab al-ḥut (al-Janubiyy), which means "the brightest (star) belonging to the tail of the (southern) fish (constellation)".
fs30_1.cn: 鹤一的英名称来自于阿拉伯语，该词派生于鹤一的阿拉伯名称al-Nayyir min Dhanab al-ḥut (al-Janubiyy),意为“属于(南)鱼（座）的尾巴的最亮的（恒星）”。

bk1_0.en: Gaia BH1 is located in the constellation Ophiuchus and comprises a G-type main-sequence star along with a companion that is likely a stellar black hole, forming a binary system. It is situated approximately 1,560 light-years (478 parsecs) away from the Solar System. As of 2022, astronomers had reason to believe that it is the closest known black hole system to Earth.
bk1_0.cn: 盖亚BH1位于蛇夫座，包含一颗G型主序星和一颗可能是恒星黑洞的联星，与太阳系的距离大约1,560光年（478秒差距）。截至2022年，天文学家有理由相信，它是已知最接近的黑洞系统。

bk1_1.en: The star and the black hole orbit each other with a period of 185.59 days and have an orbital eccentricity of 0.45. The star has a mass and radius similar to that of the Sun, with an effective surface temperature of about 5,850 Kelvin.
bk1_1.cn: 这颗恒星和黑洞以185.59天的周期相绕着公转，离心率为0.45。恒星的质量与半径和太阳相近，表面有效温度大约是5,850K。

bk2_0.en: 盖亚BH3是由一颗光谱类型为G的贫金属巨星和一颗恒星质量黑洞组成的一个联星系统。它位于天鹰座，距离1,926光年（590.6±5.8秒差距）。
bk2_0.cn: Gaia BH3 is a binary system composed of a metal-poor giant star with a spectral type G and a stellar-mass black hole. It is located in the constellation Aquila, at a distance of 1,926 light-years (590.6 ± 5.8 parsecs) from Earth.

bk2_1.en: The black hole and the giant star orbit the system's center of mass once every 11.6 years, with their orbital separation ranging from 4.5 to 29 astronomical units (AU). The black hole has a mass of 32.70 times that of the Sun, making it the heaviest known stellar black hole in the Milky Way.
bk2_1.cn: 黑洞和恒星每11.6年绕系统质心运行一次，轨道距离从4.5–29 AU。黑洞的质量是太阳的32.70倍，是银河系中已知最重的恒星黑洞。

bk2_2.en: Gaia BH3 was found to be part of a disrupted low-mass star cluster, which is now a stellar stream called ED-2 in the Galactic halo. This stream is very old, comparable in age to the globular cluster M92. This suggests that Gaia BH3 likely formed more than 13 billion years ago and may have originated from the direct collapse of a massive star.
bk2_2.cn: 盖亚BH3被发现是一个低质量星团被中断的一部分，这个部分目前是银晕中称为ED-2的星流。这个星流非常古老，其年龄可与球状星团M92相媲美。这意味着盖亚BH3可能形成于130多亿年前，并可能是通过大质量恒星的直接坍塌形成的。

bk3_0.en: Gaia BH2 is a binary system composed of a red giant and what is very likely a stellar-mass black hole. Located in the constellation Centaurus, Gaia BH2 is approximately 3,800 light-years away from Earth, making it the second closest known black hole system to our planet.
bk3_0.cn: 盖亚BH2是由红巨星和很可能是恒星质量黑洞组成的一个联星系统。盖亚BH2位于半人马座，距离在3,800光年外，使其成为距离地球第二近的黑洞系统。

bk3_1.en: The black hole and the red giant orbit the system's center of mass once every 1,277 days (about 3.5 years), with a moderate orbital eccentricity of 0.518. The black hole has a mass estimated to be about 8.94 times that of the Sun, while the red giant has a mass of approximately 1.07 solar masses and a radius about 7.77 times larger than the Sun, with an estimated surface temperature of 4,604 Kelvin.
bk3_1.cn: 黑洞和红巨星每1,277天（约3.5年）绕系统重心运行一次，离心率为中等的0.518。黑洞的质量大约太阳的8.94倍，红巨星的质量约是1.07倍，半径为7.77其温度估计为4,604K。

bk4_0.en: A0620-00 is a stellar-mass black hole candidate located in the constellation Monoceros. It resides in a binary system consisting of a more massive component and a less massive companion, where the more massive star has evolved into a black hole.
bk4_0.cn: A0620-00是位于麒麟座的恒星质量黑洞候选者。它位于一个双星系统中，其中一颗质量较大，而另一颗质量比较小，大质量的恒星变成黑洞。

bk4_1.en: Its mass is currently estimated to be 6.6 times that of the Sun.
bk4_1.cn: 它的质量目前估计是太阳质量的6 .6倍。

bk5_0.en: OGLE-2011-BLG-0462, also known as MOA-2011-BLG-191, is a stellar-mass black hole isolated in interstellar space. OGLE-2011-BLG-0462 lies at a distance of 1,720 parsecs (5,610 light years) in the direction of the galactic bulge in the constellation Sagittarius.
bk5_0.cn: OGLE-2011-BLG-0462，也被称为MOA-2011-BLG-191，是一个孤立于星际空间中的恒星质量黑洞。OGLE-2011-BLG-0462位于射手座方向的银河核球区域内，距离地球约1,720秒差距（5,610光年）。

bk5_1.en: The black hole has a mass of about 6.03 times that of the Sun. OGLE-2011-BLG-0462 is the first truly isolated black hole which has been confirmed.
bk5_1.cn: 该黑洞的质量约为6.03倍太阳质量。OGLE-2011-BLG-0462是首个被确认的真正孤立的黑洞。

bk6_0.en: XTE J1118+480 is a low-mass X-ray binary in the constellation Ursa Major. It is a soft X-ray transient that most likely contains a black hole and is probably a microquasar.
bk6_0.cn: XTE J1118+480 是大熊座中的一个低质量X射线双星系统。它是一个软X射线暂现源，最有可能包含一个黑洞，并且很可能是一个微类星体。

bk6_1.en: XTE is the standard designation for objects discovered by this satellite. It is also catalogued as 2MASS J11181079+4802126 in the Two-Micron All Sky Survey catalogue of infrared objects, and has been given the variable star designation KV Ursae Majoris
bk6_1.cn: XTE 是由该卫星发现的天体的标准命名。它也在两微米全天巡天（2MASS）红外天体目录中被编录，编号为 2MASS J11181079+4802126，并且被赋予了变星名称 KV Ursae Majoris。

bk7_0.en: Cygnus X-1 is a binary star system located in the constellation Cygnus within the Milky Way galaxy. It is a famous X-ray source that was discovered during a rocket flight in 1964 and is one of the strongest X-ray sources observed from Earth.
bk7_0.cn: 天鹅座X-1是一个银河系内位于天鹅座的双星系统，是著名的X射线源。它在1964年的一次火箭弹道飞行时被发现，是从地球观测最强的X射线源之一。

bk7_1.en: Cygnus X-1 was one of the first objects to be widely recognized as a black hole candidate and remains one of the most intensely studied objects of its kind. Current estimates place its mass at 14.8 times that of the Sun, and its density is so high that a black hole is considered the only plausible explanation.
bk7_1.cn: 天鹅座X-1是最先被广泛承认为黑洞的候选星体，也是同类星体中最受研究关注的。现在估计其质量为太阳质量的14.8倍，而其密度之高使黑洞成为唯一一种解释。

bk7_2.en: Located approximately 6,070 light-years from the Sun, Cygnus X-1 consists of a black hole and a supergiant variable star cataloged as HDE 226868.
bk7_2.cn: 天鹅座X-1距离太阳大约6,070光年，另一成员为一颗超巨星变星，编号为HDE226868。

bk7_3.en: The two stars orbit each other at a distance of 0.2 astronomical units. The stellar wind from the supergiant star provides material for the accretion disk surrounding the X-ray source, which is believed to be the black hole.
bk7_3.cn: 两者相互围绕公转，距离为0.2天文单位。该星的星风为X射线源的吸积盘提供物质。

milky way.name: MilkyWay Subgroup
milky way.desc: 银河系周边一些较小星系受到银河引力约束，构成银河系次星系群的一部分，这个次集团又是本星系群的一部分。大约有30个小星系已经证实是在银河系的420千秒差距（140万光年）之内，虽然不是所有的小星系都必定在轨道上。其中，肉眼可见的只有大麦哲伦星系，小麦哲伦星系，自从史前时代从已被观察到。哈勃太空望远镜于2006年的测量表明麦哲伦星系可能移动得太快而不是在绕银河系的轨道上[2]。其中，在已证实是在轨道上的星系中，最大的是人马座矮椭球星系，这是一个直径有20000光年（6100秒差距），大约是银河系直径的五分之一。

M31.name: M31 Subgroup
M31.desc: 仙女座星系的卫星星系已经被发现了14个。其中最大与最亮的M32椭圆星系、第二亮且最靠近的M110椭圆星系，使用业余的小望远镜就能看见。其他的卫星星系都不容易看见，而且它们都是最近这几年才首度被发现的。

M33.name: M33 Subgroup
M33.desc: 本星系群的第三大星系，其中双鱼座矮星系是其一个卫星星系。研究表明，M33和M31在过去的20至80亿年前曾发生过交互作用， 而它们之间猛烈的碰撞预计将在20亿年之后再次发生。届时其有可能参与仙女座星系和银河系的碰撞或被抛出本星系群。

Local.name: Local Group
Local.desc: 我们所在的星系群，包括约54个星系，如银河系、仙女座星系、三角座星系等。

Maffei.name: Maffei Group
Maffei.desc: 也被称为IC 342星系群，是离银河系所在的本星系群最近的星系群。它可能曾经是本星系群的一部分，但由于与仙女座星系发生过激烈的接触而被抛出。

Canes.name: Canes Group
Canes.desc: 最亮的成员是M94和M106，是一个位于猎犬座和后发座内，结构松散，距离我们大约1300万光年的星系群，这个星系群在室女座超星系团（本超星系团）之内，是众多的成员之一。

Canes-II.name: Canes-II Group
Canes-II.desc: 在猎犬座的方向上，属于本超星系团，距离地球约2610万光年的星系群。群中最大的星系是M106（NGC 4258），是一个棒旋星系。

Leo-I.name: Leo-I Group
Leo-I.desc: M96星系群 （也称为狮子I星系群）是位于狮子座内的一个星系群，有8至24个星系，其中包括3个梅西尔天体。这个星系群是室女座超星系团（本超星系团）的一分子。

Virgo.name: Virgo Cluster
Virgo.desc: 室女座超星系团的中心，包含约1300-2000个星系，如M87、M49、M86等。它是室女座超星系团内最大的星系团。

Sculptor.name: Sculptor Cluster
Sculptor.desc: 玉夫座星系群是一个松散的星系群，位置接近南银极。 这个星系群是最靠近本星系群的星系群之一，从银河到该星系群中心的距离大约是12.7百万光年。

Dorado.name: Dorado Group
Dorado.desc: 剑鱼座星系团是一个松散的星系集团，不仅有螺旋星系也有椭圆星系。它通常被视为一个星系群，但已经接近星系团的大小，它的成员主要分布在剑鱼座，并且是南半球最富有的星系群之一。

Fornax.name: Fornax Cluster
Fornax.desc: 天炉座星系团距离银河系约6千万光年远处 ，它虽远比室女座星系团小许多，但仍是在1亿光年范围内排名第二的富星系团。包含约60个星系，如NGC 1399、NGC 1404等。

Eridanus.name: Eridanus Cluster
Eridanus.desc: 位于波江座，包含约200个星系，如NGC 1407、NGC 1332等。是波江座附近的一个松散星系群，平均距离约为75百万光年。红移值显示大约有200个星系与该群相关，其中大约70%是螺旋型和不规则型星系，其余30%是椭圆型和透镜型星系。

Pegasus.name: Perseus Cluster
Pegasus.desc: 是位于英仙座的一个星系团，它的红移为5,366公里/秒，直径为863′。这个星系团在X射线的观察下是天空中最明亮的星系团之一。星系NGC 1275为于星系团的中心，该处的X射线最明亮。

Coma.name: Coma Cluster
Coma.desc: 是一个巨大的星系团，拥有1000个以上被确认的星系。这个星系团与地球的平均距离是9900万秒差距（3亿2100万光年)，其中最亮的10个螺旋星系的视星等在12至14等之间，业余天文学家使用口径20公分以上的望远镜就能看见。在中间主宰著星系团的是两个巨大的椭圆星系： NGC 4874和NGC 4889。

Pavo-Indus.cname: 孔雀座和印第安座星系团
Pavo-Indus.name: Pavo-Indus Cluster
Pavo-Indus.desc: 位于孔雀座和印第安座，包含约50个星系，如NGC 6752、NGC 6744等。

Antlia.name: Antlia Cluster
Antlia.desc: 位于唧筒座，包含约30个星系，如NGC 3268、NGC 3258等。

Centaurus.name: Centaurus Cluster
Centaurus.desc: 是拥有数百个星系的星系集团，位于半人马座的方向上，距离一亿五千五百万光年远，最亮的星系是NGC 4696、NGC 4622等。

Hydra.name: Hydra Cluster
Hydra.desc: 是有157个明亮星系的星系集团，从地球上看他的位置在长蛇座。这个星系团跨越了千万光年的距离，并且有异常高比例的暗物质。这个星系团是长蛇-半人马座超星系团的一部分，距离地球一亿五千八百万光年，集团中最大的星系是椭圆星系NGC 3309、NGC 3311和螺旋星系NGC 3312，它们的直径都大约是15万光年。

Virgo SC.name: Local Supercluster
Virgo SC.desc: 是一个不规则的超星系团，包含银河系和仙女座星系所属的本星系群在内，至少有100个星系团与星系群聚集在直径33百万秒差距（1亿1千万光年）的空间内，是在可观测宇宙中数以百万计的超星系团中的一个。室女座超星系团是拉尼亚凯亚超星系团的一部分，它也是星系细丝双鱼-鲸鱼座超星系团复合体的一部分。该星系团的中心区域距离地球有6,000万光年，位于室女座，著名的梅西耶天体M49、M60、M86、M87均位于此。

Hydra–Centaurus SC.name: Hydra–Centaurus Supercluster
Hydra–Centaurus SC.cname: 长蛇-半人马座超星系团
Hydra–Centaurus SC.desc: 是一个被分为两个部分并且最靠近银河系所在的室女座超星系团的超星系团。这个超星系团在半人马座的部分可以分为4个主要的星系集团（A3526（半人马座星系团）、A3565、A3574和A3581），还有长蛇座星系团（A1060）和矩尺座星系团（A3627）。除了中央的星系集团之外，在1.5亿至2亿光年的距离上，还有一些较小的星系集团也属于这一个超星系团。

Perseus–Pisces SC.name: Perseus–Pisces Supercluster
Perseus–Pisces SC.desc: 是宇宙已知结构中最大的之一，在远达2亿5千万光年处，由星系团组成的长链北半球冬季跨越过40°的天空。英仙-双鱼超星系团是在邻近的宇宙（3亿光年之内）两处星系密集的区域之一，沿着银河系的平面延伸，位于室女超星系团的另一侧。

Pavo–Indus SC.name: Pavo–Indus Supercluster
Pavo–Indus SC.desc: 邻近本超星系团的一个超星系团。这个超星系团有4个主要的星系团：A3656、A3698、A3742和A3747，并团呈现出巨墙或丝状结构，其总长度延伸至66Mpc（215百万光年）。

Coma SC.name: Coma Supercluster
Coma SC.desc: 拥有后发座星系团（A1656）和狮子座星系团 （A1367）两个星系团。距离地球大约3亿光年，位于长城的中心，是最接近我们所在的室女座超星系团中的超星系团。他的外型大致是球形，直径大约二千万光年，包含3,000个以上的星系。它位于后发座，是第一个被发现的超星系团，后发座超星系团帮助天文学家了解宇宙的结构。

Hercules SC.name: Hercules Supercluster
Hercules SC.desc: 是由两个邻近的超星系团构成的一对星系集团。相较于其它地方的超星系团，这个集团被认为是特别的巨大，它的直径大约达到3.3亿光年。在这个星系团前方有着和这个超星系团一样大的北方本超空洞。这个区域中包括A2147、A2151（武仙座星系团）、和A2152星系团。已经发现一条极长的丝状结构连接到A2197和A2199这一对星系团，在邻近北冕座内的A2162也是这个集团的成员。

Shapley SC.name: Shapley Supercluster
Shapley SC.desc: 在我们邻近的宇宙空间中形成一个重力互动、星系最浓稠的单位。其庞大的星系密度使其凝聚在一起而压制了扩展中的宇宙本身带来的空间膨胀。夏普力超星系团在星系的分布上看起来是集中在半人马座的方向上，距离银河系大约6亿5千万光年远。

Leo SC.name: Leo Supercluster
Leo SC.desc: 一个在北天球的超星系团，该超星系团跨越大熊座和狮子座，覆盖约130百万秒差距长，60百万秒差距宽的面积。它的星系团成员的红移量由0.032到0.043不等。该超星系团中最亮的星系团是A1185。

Corona Borealis SC.name: Corona Borealis Supercluster
Corona Borealis SC.desc: 位于冠座座和北半球天球中最显著的超星团之一，与其他超星团相比，它更加致密和紧凑。据计算，其质量介于0.6到12×10^16个太阳质量之间。它包含星系团A2056、A2061、A2065（超星团内最庞大的星系团）、A2067、A2079、A2089和A2092。

Horologium SC.name: Horologium Supercluster
Horologium SC.desc: 是一个大质量的超星系团，横跨5亿5千万光年和拥有大约10^17太阳质量。这个超星系团最靠近我们的部分大约有7亿光年的距离，远端的距离则远达12亿光年，分布在时钟座和波江座。时钟座超星系团大约有5000个星系团（30000个大星系和300000个矮星系）。

Ophiuchus SC.name: Ophiuchus Supercluster
Ophiuchus SC.desc: 是位于蛇夫座的一个邻近星系超星团。该超星团构成了蛇夫座空洞的远壁；它还可能与孔雀-印第安-望远镜座超星团和武仙座超星团相连成一个丝状结构。这个超星团以cD星团（Abell分类I型）蛇夫座星团为中心，至少还包括另外两个星系团、四个星系群和几个星系成员。

CfA2.name: CfA2 Great Wall
CfA2.desc: 这是宇宙中第一个被发现的超大的大尺度结构，但这不是完整的结构，它是此类结构中第二大的。长城的核心是CfA侏儒，后发座超星系团构成了大部分的侏儒结构，后发座星系团处于核心。

SulW.name: Sculptor Great Wall
SulW.desc: 一个相对靠近银河系的星系超级结构（星系长城），也是一般所谓的玉夫座超星系团。这个超级结构也称为南方长城、南墙，以与北方长城或直接称为长城的CfA2长城相呼应。。

SGW.name: Sloan Great Wall
SGW.desc: 由星系组成的巨墙，是目前所知宇宙中被观察到的最巨大“非结构”，由普林斯顿大学在2003年10月对外公布。依据史隆数位巡天所获得的资料，这座巨墙的长城远在10亿光年之外，长达13.8亿光年。

HGW.name: Hercules-Corona Borealis Great Wall
HGW.desc: 宇宙中一个由星系组成的巨大超结构，延伸超过100亿光年，是可观测宇宙中已知最巨大的结构。天文学家于2013年11月使用雨燕卫星和费米伽玛射线空间望远镜的观测资料将发生在遥远宇宙的多次伽玛射线暴位置绘制成分布图时发现了这个巨大结构。
